name: Remnic OpenClaw Plugin
description: Local semantic memory for OpenClaw with bundled Remnic core runtime. Requires plugins.slots.memory set to this plugin id for hooks to fire.

providerAuthChoices.choiceLabel: Optional OpenAI API key for Remnic plugin-mode extraction
providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: Not needed when Remnic uses the OpenClaw gateway model source. Set only if you intentionally use plugin mode with OpenAI or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
providerAuthChoices.cliDescription: Optional OpenAI API key used by Remnic plugin-mode extraction, consolidation, and embedding flows.

abstractionAnchorsEnabled.description: Enable typed cue-anchor indexing for abstraction nodes and expose it through cue-anchor status tooling.

abstractionNodeStoreDir.description: Override the abstraction-node store directory (defaults to {memoryDir}/state/abstraction-nodes).

accessTrackingBufferMaxSize.description: Max entries in access tracking buffer before flush

accessTrackingEnabled.description: Track memory access counts and recency

actionGraphRecallEnabled.description: Write action-conditioned causal-stage edges from typed trajectory records into the causal graph.

activeContextMaxMessages.description: Max messages accepted in one active-context snapshot.

activeContextMaxSnapshotChars.description: Max total content chars accepted in one active-context snapshot.

activeContextMinRetainedMessages.description: Floor on messages retained after an active-context plan applies.

activeContextPlanTtlMinutes.description: TTL in minutes for active-context plans and retained snapshots.

activeContextRetentionMaxBytes.description: Max bytes for the adapter-local retained source snapshot.

activeContextSummaryMaxTokens.description: Max output tokens for one SUMMARY replacement.

activeContextTransformLlmEnabled.description: Permit method=llm active-context SUMMARY plans; auto degrades to deterministic when off.

activeRecallAgents.description: Optional allowlist of OpenClaw agent ids that may use active recall.

activeRecallAllowChainedActiveMemory.description: Compat-only: allow the Remnic active-recall block to chain into the bundled active-memory surface. Redundant in modern OpenClaw memory-slot mode; only set true when intentionally layering Remnic + bundled active-memory for the same agent.

activeRecallAllowedChatTypes.description: OpenClaw chat types eligible for active recall.

activeRecallAttachRecallExplain.description: Attach recall explain output to active-recall diagnostics.

activeRecallCacheTtlMs.description: Cache TTL for active-recall summaries; 0 disables the cache.

activeRecallCustomInstruction.description: Optional custom guidance for the active-recall builder.

activeRecallEnabled.description: Enable the optional Remnic-native pre-reply recall block. Memory-slot prompt injection does not require it.

activeRecallEntityGraphDepth.description: Entity-graph traversal depth used by active recall.

activeRecallIncludeCausalTrajectories.description: Include causal trajectory recall evidence in active-recall summaries.

activeRecallIncludeDaySummary.description: Include the latest day summary in active-recall context.

activeRecallMaxSummaryChars.description: Maximum summary size produced by the active-recall surface.

activeRecallModel.description: Optional model selection for active recall.

activeRecallModelFallbackPolicy.description: How active recall falls back when an explicit model cannot be resolved.

activeRecallPersistTranscripts.description: Persist full active-recall request and response transcripts.

activeRecallPromptAppend.description: Optional additional guidance for the active-recall builder.

activeRecallPromptOverride.description: Legacy optional custom instruction for the active-recall builder.

activeRecallPromptReplacement.description: Optional complete replacement prompt for the active-recall builder.

activeRecallPromptStyle.description: Context assembly style for the active-recall surface.

activeRecallQueryMode.description: How much recent OpenClaw conversation context is fed into the active-recall query builder.

activeRecallRecentAssistantChars.description: Per-assistant-turn character cap for active-recall context assembly.

activeRecallRecentAssistantTurns.description: How many recent assistant turns to include in the active-recall query context.

activeRecallRecentUserChars.description: Per-user-turn character cap for active-recall context assembly.

activeRecallRecentUserTurns.description: How many recent user turns to include in the active-recall query context.

activeRecallThinking.description: Reasoning effort used by the active-recall engine.

agentAccessHttp.description: Optional: run a local authenticated HTTP API so non-OpenClaw clients can query Engram directly.

enabled.description: Start the local Engram HTTP access server during plugin startup.

host.description: Loopback host to bind for the Engram HTTP access server.

port.description: Bind port for the Engram HTTP access server. Use 0 for an ephemeral port.

writeRateLimitMaxRequests.description: Max write requests (memory stores, observes) per rolling window before the HTTP API returns 429 write_rate_limited. Positive integer.

writeRateLimitWindowMs.description: Rolling window for the write rate limit, in milliseconds. Positive integer.

authToken.description: Bearer token for the local Remnic HTTP API. Literal string (${ENV_VAR} ok) or OpenClaw SecretRef resolved at startup. If omitted, uses OPENCLAW_REMNIC_ACCESS_TOKEN / OPENCLAW_ENGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN.

principal.description: Optional trusted principal bound to the local Engram access bridge. When set, namespace write authorization is evaluated against this principal instead of any client-supplied sessionKey. If omitted, OPENCLAW_ENGRAM_ACCESS_PRINCIPAL is used when present.

maxBodyBytes.description: Maximum accepted JSON request body size for the local Remnic HTTP API.

autoPromoteToSharedCategories.description: Categories eligible for auto-promotion to shared.

autoPromoteToSharedEnabled.description: If enabled, Engram may auto-promote selected categories to shared (reserved; conservative).

backgroundGeneration.description: Chat-only Hermes loopback bridge. Consumed only by hourly background generation. Never assigned to openaiBaseUrl.

endpoint.description: Full chat-completions URL for the Hermes loopback bridge.

token.description: Loopback bearer from the generated client file.

timeoutSeconds.description: Absolute deadline in seconds for one background-generation request.

timeout_seconds.description: Snake-case alias of timeoutSeconds used by the generated Hermes client file.

beforeResetTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for a reset-triggered flush before returning control to OpenClaw.

behaviorLoopAutoTuneEnabled.description: Enable runtime behavior-loop policy auto-tuning (v8.15, default off).

behaviorLoopLearningWindowDays.description: Rolling signal window used for behavior-loop policy learning (days; 0 allowed).

behaviorLoopMaxDeltaPerCycle.description: Maximum absolute parameter delta allowed per learning cycle (0-1).

behaviorLoopMinSignalCount.description: Minimum signal volume required before behavior-loop adjustments are emitted (0 allowed).

behaviorLoopProtectedParams.description: Runtime parameters that auto-tuning must never modify.

benchmarkBaselineSnapshotsEnabled.description: Enable versioned benchmark baseline snapshot artifacts under the eval store for later PR delta reporting.

benchmarkDeltaReporterEnabled.description: Enable named-baseline delta reports so PR candidates can be compared against stored benchmark baselines.

benchmarkStoredBaselineEnabled.description: Enable stored baseline comparisons for benchmark delta reporting.

binaryLifecycleBackendPath.description: Base path for the filesystem storage backend.

binaryLifecycleBackendType.description: Storage backend for binary lifecycle mirror stage.

binaryLifecycleEnabled.description: Enable binary file lifecycle management. When true, binary files in the memory directory are mirrored, redirected, and cleaned.

binaryLifecycleGracePeriodDays.description: Days to wait before cleaning local copies of mirrored binary files.

boostAccessCount.description: Boost frequently accessed memories in search results

boxMaxMemories.description: Maximum memories per box before forced seal.

boxRecallDays.description: Number of recent days of boxes to add during recall.

boxTimeGapMs.description: Time gap in milliseconds before an open box is sealed (default 30 min).

boxTopicShiftThreshold.description: Jaccard overlap threshold below which a topic shift seals the current box (0–1).

briefing.description: Daily Context Briefing. Knobs: enabled, defaultWindow, defaultFormat (markdown|json), maxFollowups (0-10), calendarSource (ICS/JSON path, null = off), saveByDefault, saveDir (null = $REMNIC_HOME/briefings/), llmFollowups.

bufferSaveDebounceMs.description: Debounce (ms) for persisting the smart buffer to state/buffer.json. Steady-state writes coalesce on a trailing-edge timer; extraction trigger/clear and shutdown flush immediately. 0 saves every turn. Capped at 2147483647.

bufferSurpriseK.description: Number of nearest-neighbor memories to average over when computing the surprise score. Clamped to the recent-memory window size.

bufferSurpriseProbeTimeoutMs.description: Hard timeout (ms) for the surprise probe. If the probe does not resolve within this window the buffer treats it as failed and falls through to the existing triggers - a slow or hung embedder cannot stall the turn-append path.

bufferSurpriseRecentMemoryCount.description: Maximum number of recent memories sampled for surprise scoring. Bounds embedding cost per turn. Set to 0 to effectively disable the trigger even when the flag is on.

bufferSurpriseThreshold.description: Threshold in [0, 1] above which a surprise score flushes the buffer. Higher = require more novelty to flush. Ignored when bufferSurpriseTriggerEnabled is false.

bufferSurpriseTriggerEnabled.description: (D-MEM). When true, the smart buffer flushes immediately on turns whose embedding-based surprise score exceeds bufferSurpriseThreshold, in addition to the existing turn-count / signal / time triggers. Additive only - never suppresses existing flushes. Off by default.

calibrationEnabled.description: Enable recall calibration rules (v9.0, default off).

calibrationMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of calibration content to include per recall pass.

calibrationMaxRulesPerRecall.description: Maximum number of calibration rules to include per recall pass.

captureMode.description: Memory capture policy. implicit preserves normal extraction, explicit stores only structured capture, and hybrid allows both.

causalGraphEnabled.description: Build causal inference graph from heuristic phrases (requires multiGraphMemoryEnabled). Default true.

causalRuleExtractionEnabled.description: PlugMem-inspired causal rule extraction: mine IF-THEN rules from conversations during consolidation

causalTrajectoryMemoryEnabled.description: Enable Engram's causal-trajectory memory foundation for typed goal-action-observation-outcome chains.

causalTrajectoryRecallEnabled.description: Add recall-relevant causal trajectories to recall context.

causalTrajectoryStoreDir.description: Override the causal-trajectory memory directory (defaults to {memoryDir}/state/causal-trajectories).

chat.description: Conversational memory inspection and correction. A bounded tool-loop agent over read-only + confirmation-gated mutating tools. Off by default - spawns LLM calls so explicit opt-in.

enabled.description: Master gate. Off = no chat tools/endpoints/CLI registered (byte-identical surfaces, rule 39).

model.description: Routing override for the chat LLM. Empty = use the default routing chain (local Ollama/vLLM fully supported).

maxToolCallsPerTurn.description: Max tool calls per user turn before partial-reply fallback.

sessionTtlHours.description: Hours after which idle chat session state is cleaned up.

chunkingEnabled.description: Enable automatic chunking of long memories

chunkingOverlapSentences.description: Number of sentences to overlap between chunks

citationsAutoDetect.description: Auto-enable citations when the Codex adapter is detected.

citationsEnabled.description: Enable oai-mem-citation blocks in recall responses for Codex citation parity.

cmcBehaviorConfidenceThreshold.description: Minimum confidence threshold for CMC behavior patterns (0-1).

cmcBehaviorLearningEnabled.description: Enable CMC behavior pattern learning (default off).

cmcBehaviorMinFrequency.description: Minimum frequency for a behavior pattern to be learned by CMC.

cmcBehaviorMinSessions.description: Minimum sessions a behavior must appear in before CMC learns it.

cmcConsolidationMinRecurrence.description: Minimum recurrence count before a CMC pattern is consolidated.

cmcConsolidationMinSessions.description: Minimum sessions a CMC pattern must appear in before consolidation.

cmcConsolidationSuccessThreshold.description: Minimum success ratio required to consolidate a CMC pattern (0-1).

cmcEnabled.description: Enable Causal Memory Consolidation (CMC) subsystem (default off).

cmcLifecycleCausalImpactWeight.description: Weight of causal impact score in CMC lifecycle scoring.

cmcRetrievalCounterfactualBoost.description: Score boost applied to counterfactual nodes during CMC retrieval (0-1).

cmcRetrievalEnabled.description: Enable CMC retrieval at recall time (default off).

cmcRetrievalMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of CMC content included per recall pass.

cmcRetrievalMaxDepth.description: Maximum graph depth traversed during CMC retrieval.

cmcStitchLookbackDays.description: Number of days to look back when stitching causal trajectories.

cmcStitchMaxEdgesPerTrajectory.description: Maximum edges per trajectory during CMC stitching.

cmcStitchMinScore.description: Minimum score for a causal edge to be stitched into a trajectory.

installExtension.description: Install the Remnic Codex memory extension during Codex connector setup.

codexHome.description: Optional Codex home directory override used for connector install and materialization.

codexMarketplaceEnabled.description: Enable Codex marketplace integration for plugin discovery and installation.

codexMaterializeMaxSummaryTokens.description: Script-aware estimated-token cap for Codex memory summary materialization.

codexMaterializeMemories.description: Enable Codex native memory materialization into the Codex memories directory.

codexMaterializeNamespace.description: Namespace to materialize for Codex. "auto" derives the namespace from the active connector context.

codexMaterializeOnConsolidation.description: Run Codex memory materialization after semantic or causal consolidation completes.

codexMaterializeOnSessionEnd.description: Run Codex memory materialization from the Codex session-end hook.

codexMaterializeRolloutRetentionDays.description: Retention window in days for Codex rollout materialization artifacts.

actionGate.description: Action-site failure gate: advisory delivery of failure memories at the moment an action is proposed. Advisory only - it never blocks or delays an action.

enabled.description: Master gate. When false there are no gate lookups, no matching, and no suppression bookkeeping on any path.

timeoutMs.description: Hard latency cap for one gate evaluation. Overrun fails open with an ERROR_FAIL_OPEN record and the action proceeds.

maxAdvisoriesPerTurn.description: Advisories injected per turn, deduplicated per memory per turn (0 disables injection and all gate lookups).

codingKnowledge.description: Durable coding-knowledge surface - Track A of Master gate + per-feature switches for decision records, architecture card, session delta, and structural-context provider. Off by default so pre-feature byte-identical behaviour is preserved when disabled.

enabled.description: Master gate. Off (default) means no Track A surface fires and no new tools / briefing lines / state directories appear. On enables the switches below.

decisionRecords.description: Decision-record surfaces (list/record/supersede) + briefing titles of standing decisions. Effective only under the master gate.

architectureCard.description: Architecture-card build/refresh + briefing injection. Effective only under the master gate.

sessionDelta.description: Last-seen-head persistence + delta briefing line. Effective only under the master gate.

architectureCardLlmSummary.description: Opt-in LLM summary pass on the architecture card. Costs tokens; default off. Effective only under the master and card gates.

structuralProvider.description: Structural-context provider selection: "none" (default) keeps review-context file-path-only, "subprocess" shells out to structuralProviderCommand via execFile (argv array), "native" adapts the in-family engine when @remnic/coding-graph is installed.

structuralProviderCommand.description: Absolute path to the subprocess binary when structuralProvider = "subprocess". Empty string = no command configured. The consumer validates existence at boot.

codegraphTools.description: Gate for the 14 codegraph parity tools. Off by default - tools/list, HTTP routes, and CLI help are byte-identical to pre-feature until this is true. Also requires @remnic/coding-graph to be installed.

codegraphDbDir.description: Root directory for per-project graph SQLite DBs. Empty string = derive from memoryDir (<memoryDir>/codegraph/<principal>/<projectId>.sqlite). Absolute path required when set explicitly.

lsp.description: Phase B type resolution via LSP. When enabled, codegraph_index runs LSP after the heuristic reindex to upgrade unresolved call-site edges. Requires installed language servers. Off by default.

enabled.description: Master gate for LSP resolution. Off = heuristic edges only.

servers.description: Per-language server launch-spec overrides. Keys are language ids (typescript, python, go, rust,..); values replace the built-in default command for that language.

command.description: Server executable (resolved on PATH or absolute).

maxRequestsPerRun.description: Max LSP definition requests per index run.

projectScope.description: When true and the session has a resolved git context, memory routes to a project-scoped namespace (project:<id>). Set to false to restore pre-#569 behaviour exactly.

branchScope.description: When true, memory also overlays the current branch (project:<id>/branch:<name>). Opt-in - most development wants cross-branch recall. Wired in of #569.

globalFallback.description: When true (default), project-scoped sessions include the root/default namespace in read fallbacks so globally useful memories remain visible. Set to false for strict project isolation.

collectJudgeTrainingPairs.description: Opt-in collector for (candidate_text, verdict_kind, reason) tuples used to prep a future GRPO training pipeline. Rows land under ~/.remnic/judge-training/<date>.jsonl (NOT in the shared memory directory). Off by default.

commandsListEnabled.description: Advertise Remnic slash-command descriptors through the registerCommand runtime surface.

commitmentDecayDays.description: Days before fulfilled/expired commitments are removed

commitmentLedgerDir.description: Override the commitment ledger directory (defaults to {memoryDir}/state/commitment-ledger).

commitmentLedgerEnabled.description: Enable the explicit commitment ledger for promises, follow-ups, deadlines, and unfinished obligations.

commitmentLifecycleEnabled.description: Enable commitment lifecycle transitions, stale tracking, and resolved-entry cleanup for the commitment ledger.

commitmentStaleDays.description: Days before an open commitment without a due date is considered stale in lifecycle status.

compactionResetEnabled.description: Trigger session reset after compaction with BOOT.md recovery context (requires OC fork with api.resetSession)

compoundingInjectEnabled.description: Inject compounded mistakes/patterns into recall when compounding is enabled.

compoundingWeeklyCronEnabled.description: If true, compounding weekly synthesis can be scheduled externally via cron.

compressionGuidelineLearningEnabled.description: Enable adaptive compression guideline learning from memory-action outcomes (v8.3, default off).

compressionGuidelineSemanticRefinementEn.description: Enable optional semantic refinement pass after deterministic guideline candidate generation (v8.11, default off).

compressionGuidelineSemanticTimeoutMs.description: Hard timeout in milliseconds for semantic refinement; timeout fail-opens to deterministic output.

connectors.description: Live-connector configuration. Each child object maps to one concrete LiveConnector. Defaults are off; operators must opt in.

googleDrive.description: Google Drive live connector (N). Imports text content from a user's Drive into Remnic on a poll schedule.

enabled.description: Master gate. Default off - set to true to enable Drive imports. The connector additionally requires clientId, clientSecret, and refreshToken to be populated before it will run.

clientId.description: OAuth2 client id. Populate from your secret store (e.g. ${GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_ID}). Never commit a real value to source.

clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret. Populate from your secret store (e.g. ${GOOGLE_DRIVE_CLIENT_SECRET}). Never commit a real value to source.

refreshToken.description: OAuth2 refresh token issued for the user's Drive scope. Populate from your secret store (e.g. ${GOOGLE_DRIVE_REFRESH_TOKEN}). Never commit a real value to source.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often the scheduler should call the connector's syncIncremental, in milliseconds. Defaults to 5 minutes; max 24 hours.

folderIds.description: Optional array of Google Drive folder ids to scope the import. Empty = all accessible files. Folder ids are validated for shape; nested folders are NOT auto-included.

notion.description: Notion live connector (N). Imports text content from Notion database pages into Remnic on a poll schedule.

enabled.description: Master gate. Default off - set to true to enable Notion imports. The connector additionally requires a token and at least one databaseId to be populated before it will run.

token.description: Notion integration token (starts with secret_). Populate from your secret store (e.g. ${NOTION_TOKEN}). Never commit a real value to source.

databaseIds.description: Array of Notion database ids to import pages from. Accepts compact 32-hex-char ids or standard UUID format. Empty = connector is a no-op.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often the scheduler should call the connector's syncIncremental, in milliseconds. Defaults to 5 minutes; max 24 hours.

gmail.description: Gmail live connector. Imports new inbox messages from Gmail into Remnic on a poll schedule.

enabled.description: Master gate. Default off - set to true to enable Gmail imports. The connector additionally requires clientId, clientSecret, and refreshToken to be populated before it will run.

clientId.description: OAuth2 client id. Populate from your secret store (e.g. ${GMAIL_CLIENT_ID}). Never commit a real value to source.

clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret. Populate from your secret store (e.g. ${GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET}). Never commit a real value to source.

refreshToken.description: OAuth2 refresh token issued for the Gmail scope. Populate from your secret store (e.g. ${GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN}). Never commit a real value to source.

userId.description: Gmail userId. Defaults to 'me' (the authenticated user). Override only in delegated-access scenarios.

query.description: Gmail search query applied in addition to the watermark after: filter. Default 'in:inbox'. Set to '' to import all mail.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often the scheduler should call the connector's syncIncremental, in milliseconds. Defaults to 5 minutes; max 24 hours.

github.description: GitHub live connector. Imports issue comments, PR review comments, and optionally discussion posts authored by the configured user from watched repos into Remnic on a poll schedule.

enabled.description: Master gate. Default off - set to true to enable GitHub imports. The connector additionally requires token, userLogin, and at least one repo to be populated before it will run.

token.description: GitHub personal access token. Populate from your secret store (e.g. ${GITHUB_TOKEN}). Never commit a real value to source.

userLogin.description: GitHub login of the user whose comments will be imported. Only comments authored by this login are ingested. Required when enabled.

repos.description: Array of repos to poll in "owner/repo" format. Empty = connector is a no-op.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often the scheduler should call the connector's syncIncremental, in milliseconds. Defaults to 5 minutes; max 24 hours.

includeDiscussions.description: Whether to import GitHub Discussion comments in addition to issue and PR review comments. Default false.

consolidationRequireNonZeroExtraction.description: Only schedule consolidation when the last extraction produced durable outputs.

contextCompressionActionsEnabled.description: Enable context compression action tooling and telemetry paths (v8.3, default off).

continuityAuditEnabled.description: Enable continuity audit artifact generation workflows

continuityIncidentLoggingEnabled.description: When unset, defaults to identityContinuityEnabled. Controls continuity incident logging artifacts.

contradictionDetectionEnabled.description: Enable automatic contradiction detection with LLM verification

contradictionMinConfidence.description: Minimum LLM confidence to auto-resolve contradictions

contradictionScan.description: Configuration for the nightly contradiction-scan cron

enabled.description: Enable the nightly contradiction scan cron (disabled by default per rule 48)

similarityFloor.description: Embedding cosine similarity floor for candidate pair generation

topicOverlapFloor.description: Minimum topic-token Jaccard overlap for unstructured pairs

maxPairsPerRun.description: Cap on candidate pairs evaluated per cron run

autoMergeDuplicates.description: Auto-flag pairs judged duplicates for dedup (still requires user approval)

contradictionLocalization.description: Anchor-first contradiction candidate localization before QMD search.

anchorEnabled.description: Enable entityRef and category anchor candidates.

anchorCandidates.description: Maximum anchor candidates. 0 disables the anchor pass.

searchCandidates.description: Maximum QMD search candidates. 0 disables text search.

maxCandidates.description: Maximum merged candidates sent to the verifier.

dependencyPropagation.description: Bounded one-hop dependency revalidation after supersession. Disabled by default.

maxDependents.description: Maximum active dependents to revalidate. 0 disables propagation.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum duration of the batched revalidation call in milliseconds.

dryRun.description: Discover and revalidate dependents without writing supersession changes.

contradictionSimilarityThreshold.description: QMD similarity threshold to trigger contradiction check

conflictPolicy.description: Default conflict policy for convergence. newest-wins selects the newer revision when both sides carry comparable timestamps; manual stops before mutation when conflicts remain.

peerRequestTimeoutMs.description: Per-request peer HTTP timeout in milliseconds for converge plan/apply/watch. Boot-scale namespaces (~100k files) can take over 30s to serve a manifest; raise this rather than watching manifest fetches time out. Clamped to 3600000 (one hour).

conversationIndexBackend.description: Backend for conversation indexing. qmd indexes chunk docs into a QMD collection; faiss uses the bundled Python sidecar and local FAISS artifacts under memoryDir/state/conversation-index/faiss.

conversationIndexEmbedOnUpdate.description: If true, conversation_index_update also runs QMD embed by default. Keep false for lower load.

conversationIndexEnabled.description: Enable conversation chunk indexing + semantic recall hook (default off).

conversationIndexFaissHealthTimeoutMs.description: Timeout (ms) for FAISS health checks. Health is fail-open and reports degraded when dependencies or local artifacts are missing.

conversationIndexFaissIndexDir.description: Relative directory under memoryDir where FAISS sidecar artifacts are stored, including index.faiss, metadata.jsonl, and manifest.json.

conversationIndexFaissMaxBatchSize.description: Maximum transcript chunk batch size per FAISS upsert call.

conversationIndexFaissMaxSearchK.description: Maximum top-K allowed for FAISS search requests.

conversationIndexFaissModelId.description: Embedding model identifier passed to the FAISS sidecar. By default the sidecar aliases OpenAI embedding ids to a local sentence-transformers model when REMNIC_FAISS_ENABLE_ST=1 (or legacy ENGRAM_FAISS_ENABLE_ST=1), and otherwise falls back to deterministic hash embeddings.

conversationIndexFaissPythonBin.description: Optional Python executable used to run the FAISS sidecar (for example python3.11).

conversationIndexFaissScriptPath.description: Optional absolute path to FAISS sidecar script. If unset, uses built-in default script location.

conversationIndexMinUpdateIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval between conversation_index_update runs per session (ms). Prevents redundant reindex churn.

conversationIndexQmdCollection.description: QMD collection to use for conversation chunk search (must be configured in ~/.config/qmd/index.yml).

conversationIndexRetentionDays.description: Days to retain conversation chunk docs.

conversationRecallMaxChars.description: Max characters of semantic conversation recall to include.

conversationRecallTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for semantic conversation recall search (ms). Fail-open on timeout.

correctionApplyRequiresConfirm.description: When true (default), memory_correct_apply requires confirm: true before mutating memory. Off allows one-shot apply without an explicit confirmation.

correctionCaptureAutoApplyMaxAffected.description: Maximum number of memories a passively-detected correction may affect in "auto" mode. Plans touching more memories than this are queued even when mode is "auto" - a blast-radius cap. Default 2.

correctionCaptureConfidenceFloor.description: Minimum planner confidence required to auto-apply a passively-detected correction in "auto" mode. Plans below this floor are queued even when mode is "auto". Default 0.85.

correctionCaptureMode.description: Passive correction capture: off, queue, or guarded auto-apply. Invalid values reject.

correction.description: Memory-correction contract - nested form; nested keys win over the flat legacy correction* keys.

enabled.description: Enable the correction contract (plan/apply). Default true.

applyRequiresConfirm.description: Require confirm: true on memory_correct_apply. Default true.

maxAffected.description: Maximum memories one correction plan may touch. Default 10.

planTtlHours.description: Hours a planned correction stays applicable. Default 24.

correctionCapture.description: Implicit correction capture (nested form; nested keys win over the flat legacy correctionCapture* keys).

confidenceFloor.description: Minimum detector confidence to act on. Default 0.85.

autoApplyMaxAffected.description: Auto-apply ceiling on affected memories. Default 2.

openclawHostEmbeddingProviderEnabled.description: Legacy alias for hostEmbeddingProviderEnabled (OpenClaw host embedding provider). Default true.

correctionEnabled.description: Master gate for the Correction Contract - the unified plan/apply pipeline for memory corrections (supersede/edit/retract/rescope/never-store). When false, the correction surfaces (CLI/HTTP/MCP) are disabled.

correctionMaxAffected.description: Maximum number of memories a single correction plan may affect. A plan exceeding this is refused rather than silently truncated. Invalid values (0/negative/non-numeric) are rejected.

correctionPlanTtlHours.description: Hours a pending correction plan remains valid before it expires and must be re-planned. Invalid values (0/negative/non-numeric) are rejected.

creationMemoryEnabled.description: Enable creation-memory foundations, including the work-product ledger for explicit outputs agents create.

cronConversationRecallMode.description: Controls conversation semantic recall in cron sessions. auto skips it for instruction-heavy prompts.

cronRecallAllowlist.description: Session-key wildcard patterns (supports *) allowed for recall when cronRecallMode=allowlist.

cronRecallInstructionHeavyTokenCap.description: Maximum token count used to build compact retrieval queries for instruction-heavy cron prompts.

cronRecallMode.description: Recall behavior for cron sessions. Use allowlist to opt specific cron sessionKeys in.

cronRecallNormalizedQueryMaxChars.description: Maximum query length (characters) used for cron recall retrieval after normalization.

cronRecallPolicyEnabled.description: Enable prompt-shape-aware recall query normalization for cron sessions.

daySummaryEnabled.description: Enable end-of-day summary generation via engram.day_summary MCP tool

daySummaryTimezone.description: Timezone for the day summary cron (e.g. 'America/Lima'). When empty, uses the server timezone.

defaultRecallNamespaces.description: Which namespaces to include by default in recall.

defaultScopeProfile.description: Optional key in scopeProfiles to use as the default hosted memory scope profile.

delinearizeEnabled.description: SimpleMem-inspired de-linearization: resolve pronouns and anchor relative dates in extracted memories

narrativeModel.description: Model for dream-journal narratives. plugin: OpenAI model id with the direct key. gateway: provider-qualified id (e.g. zai/glm-4.7-flash). Empty falls back to taskModelChain / the gateway default chain.

dreams.description: Consolidation pipeline phases config. Groups existing lifecycle/REM/deep-sleep gates under a unified namespace. Values here WIN over equivalent legacy top-level keys when set. (Note: distinct from the `dreaming` diary-surface config.)

lightSleep.description: Light-sleep phase: recent activity scoring and clustering. Mirrors lifecyclePolicyEnabled and related thresholds when not set explicitly.

enabled.description: Master switch for the light-sleep phase. Mirrors lifecyclePolicyEnabled when not set.

cadenceMs.description: Minimum interval between light-sleep passes (ms). 0 = no override; orchestrator uses its internal cadence.

promoteHeatThreshold.description: Value score above which a memory is treated as hot. Mirrors lifecyclePromoteHeatThreshold when not set.

staleDecayThreshold.description: Value score below which a memory starts to decay. Mirrors lifecycleStaleDecayThreshold when not set.

archiveDecayThreshold.description: Value score below which a memory is eligible for archive. Mirrors lifecycleArchiveDecayThreshold when not set.

filterStaleEnabled.description: Whether stale memories are filtered from recall. Mirrors lifecycleFilterStaleEnabled when not set.

rem.description: REM phase: cross-session synthesis, supersession resolution, semantic consolidation. Mirrors semanticConsolidation* keys when not set explicitly.

enabled.description: Master switch for the REM phase. Mirrors semanticConsolidationEnabled when not set.

cadenceMs.description: How often the REM pass runs (ms). Derived from semanticConsolidationIntervalHours when not set.

similarityThreshold.description: Cosine-similarity threshold for cluster membership. Mirrors semanticConsolidationThreshold when not set.

minClusterSize.description: Minimum cluster size before consolidation runs. Mirrors semanticConsolidationMinClusterSize when not set.

maxPerRun.description: Max cluster operations per run. Mirrors semanticConsolidationMaxPerRun when not set.

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum gap between consolidation passes (ms). Mirrors consolidationMinIntervalMs when not set.

deepSleep.description: Deep-sleep phase: promotion to durable memory, hot-to-cold tier migration, page-version snapshots, archive. Mirrors versioningEnabled and related keys when not set explicitly.

enabled.description: Master switch for the deep-sleep phase. Defaults false unless legacy deep-sleep surfaces are explicitly enabled; set true to allow nightly governance, tier migration, and versioning surfaces.

cadenceMs.description: Minimum interval between deep-sleep passes (ms). Default 86400000 (24h). Informational in; wires this into the cron scheduler.

versioningEnabled.description: Enable page-version snapshots on every overwrite. Mirrors versioningEnabled when not set.

versioningMaxPerPage.description: Max snapshots per memory page. Mirrors versioningMaxPerPage when not set.

embeddingFallbackEnabled.description: Enable embedding-based semantic recall fallback when QMD is unavailable or returns no matches

embeddingFallbackModel.description: Optional model identifier for embedding fallback requests. Defaults to localLlmModel for legacy installs.

embeddingFallbackProvider.description: Embedding provider selection for semantic fallback

emitLegacyTools.description: Advertise legacy engram tool aliases. Existing legacy connector entries keep compatibility by default.

enrichmentAutoOnCreate.description: Automatically enrich newly created entities when the enrichment pipeline is enabled.

enrichmentEnabled.description: Enable the external enrichment pipeline. When true, entities can be enriched via registered providers.

enrichmentMaxCandidatesPerEntity.description: Maximum enrichment candidates accepted per entity per run. Set to 0 to accept none.

entityActivityLogMaxEntries.description: Max activity entries per entity before oldest are pruned

entityGraphEnabled.description: Build entity co-reference graph (requires multiGraphMemoryEnabled). Default true.

entityRetrievalEnabled.description: Enable entity-oriented recall hints for direct entity questions and short follow-up queries.

entityRetrievalMaxChars.description: Hard character cap for the entity retrieval section.

entityRetrievalMaxHints.description: Maximum entity targets summarized in one recall pass.

entityRetrievalMaxRelatedEntities.description: Maximum related entities listed per target when confidence is high.

entityRetrievalMaxSupportingFacts.description: Maximum supporting fact/timeline snippets considered per entity target.

entityRetrievalRecentTurns.description: Recent transcript turns scanned for pronoun carry-forward and short follow-up resolution.

entitySchemas.description: Optional per-entity-type structured section schema customizations.

entitySummaryEnabled.description: Generate LLM summaries for entities during consolidation

entitySynthesisMaxTokens.description: Max tokens used when refreshing an entity synthesis from its timeline.

episodeNoteModeEnabled.description: Enable HiMem episode/note classification (v8.0 Phase 2B). Tags each extracted memory as 'episode' (time-specific event) or 'note' (stable belief/preference). Disabled by default.

episodicContextEnabled.description: Inject episode-grouped source turns for the top recalled facts. Reads structured `sources` provenance, resolves LCM archive turn ranges, and appends a compact `Source Episodes` section within the recall budget. Facts without structured provenance are skipped.

evalHarnessEnabled.description: Enable Engram's benchmark/evaluation harness foundation for tracking benchmark packs and run summaries.

evalShadowModeEnabled.description: Enable shadow-mode evaluation workflows so future benchmark instrumentation can measure memory changes without changing live recall output.

evalStoreDir.description: Override the evaluation harness state directory (defaults to {memoryDir}/state/evals).

eventOrderRecallEnabled.description: Enable event-order evidence recall for chronology questions.

eventOrderRecallMaxChars.description: Character budget for the event-order evidence recall section.

eventOrderRecallMaxResults.description: Maximum recalled items for event-order evidence.

eventOrderRecallScanWindowTokens.description: Recent-token scan window for event-order evidence.

eventOrderRecallScanWindowTurns.description: Recent-turn scan window for event-order evidence.

explicitCueRecallEnabled.description: Front-load exact LCM evidence for query-visible cues such as turns, dates, ids, files, and tools.

explicitCueRecallMaxChars.description: Character budget for the explicit cue evidence recall section.

explicitCueRecallMaxReferences.description: Maximum query-visible cues expanded by explicit cue recall.

extractionDedupeEnabled.description: Enable deduplication of near-identical extraction batches within a time window.

extractionSourceGroundingEnabled.description: Keep extracted facts, profile updates, and questions only when supported by observed source turns. Disable to preserve legacy extraction behavior.

extractionFaithfulnessContextChars.description: Context window (chars) around the verified quote sent to the faithfulness verifier.

extractionFaithfulnessGate.description: Extraction faithfulness gate. Entailment-verification of extracted facts against verified source spans. 'off' (default) = pre-feature path; 'shadow' = record verdicts only; 'enforce' = route unsupported/contradicted to pending_review.

extractionFaithfulnessModel.description: Override model/endpoint for the faithfulness verifier. Empty string = default routing chain (local then fallback).

extractionFaithfulnessTimeoutMs.description: Per-batch timeout in ms for the faithfulness check. Timeout produces a tagged error and never blocks memory writes (graceful degradation).

extractionFaithfulnessLocalParseFallback.description: Fallback for the local model-lab faithfulness endpoint. Default false surfaces malformed_output when the local endpoint returns 200 with non-verdict JSON. Set true to fall back to the configured chain on local parse failure.

extractionFaithfulnessBaseUrl.description: Base URL of a local openai-compatible faithfulness endpoint. When set with extractionFaithfulnessModel, the gate routes there first and falls back to the configured chain on failure. Empty = existing routing.

correctionIntentModel.description: Model name of a local fine-tuned correction-intent classifier (model-lab, / #1585). When set AND correctionIntentBaseUrl is set, passive-correction detection can route to it. Empty = rule-based detectPassiveCorrections is the sole detector.

correctionIntentBaseUrl.description: Base URL of a local openai-compatible endpoint serving a fine-tuned correction-intent classifier (model-lab, ). Empty = rule-based detector only.

extractionJudgeBatchSize.description: Maximum number of candidate facts sent to the judge LLM in a single batch call.

extractionJudgeEnabled.description: Enable the LLM-as-judge fact-worthiness gate. When enabled, extracted facts are evaluated for durability before being persisted. Off by default (opt-in).

extractionJudgeMaxDeferrals.description: Maximum number of times the same candidate text may be deferred by the extraction judge before the verdict is forcibly converted to 'reject'. Prevents pathological LLM responses from looping forever on ambiguous facts.

extractionJudgeModel.description: Model override for the extraction judge LLM. Empty string uses the configured local model.

extractionJudgeShadow.description: Shadow mode for the extraction judge. When true, judge verdicts are logged but all facts are still persisted regardless of the verdict.

extractionJudgeTelemetryEnabled.description: Emit structured telemetry rows to state/observation-ledger/extraction-judge-verdicts.jsonl on every judge verdict. Off by default; enable to collect defer-rate and latency metrics for operator dashboards.

extractionMaxEntitiesPerRun.description: Maximum entities persisted from a single extraction run.

extractionMaxFactsPerRun.description: Maximum facts persisted from a single extraction run.

extractionMaxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens (max_completion_tokens) for the direct-client extraction call.

extractionMaxProfileUpdatesPerRun.description: Maximum profile updates persisted from a single extraction run.

extractionMaxQuestionsPerRun.description: Maximum questions persisted from a single extraction run.

extractionMaxTurnChars.description: Maximum characters per turn fed to extraction (long turns are truncated).

extractionMinChars.description: Minimum combined user/assistant characters required before extraction runs.

extractionMinImportanceLevel.description: Minimum locally-scored importance required to persist an extracted fact. Facts below this are dropped and counted toward importance_gated. Default "low" drops only trivial chatter; raise to "normal" or higher for a stricter gate.

extractionMinUserTurns.description: Minimum number of user turns required before extraction runs.

extractionScopeClassificationEnabled.description: When enabled, the extractor classifies each fact as 'project' or 'global'. Global facts go to the shared namespace. Disable to keep all facts in the session namespace.

extractionTelemetryPrefilterEnabled.description: Skip semantic durable-memory extraction for mechanical action/state telemetry transcripts that contain no durable-memory cue. Raw transcript storage and recall still run. Disable this if you intentionally want fact extraction from action logs.

factArchivalAgeDays.description: Minimum age in days before a fact is eligible for archival.

factArchivalEnabled.description: Enable automatic archival of old, low-importance, rarely-accessed facts during consolidation.

factArchivalMaxAccessCount.description: Maximum access count for archival eligibility. Only rarely-accessed facts are archived.

factArchivalMaxImportance.description: Maximum importance score for archival eligibility (0-1). Only facts below this threshold are archived.

factArchivalProtectedCategories.description: Categories that protect a fact from archival regardless of other criteria.

factDeduplicationEnabled.description: Enable content-hash deduplication to prevent storing semantically identical facts.

fastGatewayAgentId.description: Agent persona ID for fast-tier ops (rerank, entity summaries, compression guidelines). When modelSource is 'gateway' and this is empty, fast ops use the same chain as gatewayAgentId.

feedbackEnabled.description: Enable feedback capture tool for memory relevance (thumbs up/down).

fileHygiene.description: Optional: keep OpenClaw bootstrap workspace files small and warn before silent truncation risk.

enabled.description: Master switch for file hygiene (default off).

lintEnabled.description: If true, warn when bootstrap files approach budget.

lintBudgetBytes.description: Budget in bytes used for lint warnings (approx).

lintWarnRatio.description: Warn when file size >= budget * warnRatio.

lintPaths.description: Workspace-relative paths to lint (or absolute paths).

rotateEnabled.description: If true, rotate oversized markdown files into an archive and replace with a lean index.

rotateMaxBytes.description: Rotate when a target file exceeds this size (bytes).

rotateKeepTailChars.description: How many characters of the old file to keep inline (tail) for continuity.

rotatePaths.description: Workspace-relative paths to rotate (or absolute paths).

archiveDir.description: Workspace-relative archive directory where rotated files are stored.

warningsLogEnabled.description: If true, append warnings to a log file under memoryDir.

warningsLogPath.description: memoryDir-relative path to write warnings to.

indexEnabled.description: Reserved: write an Engram index file in workspace (not required for rotation).

flushOnResetEnabled.description: Flush buffered turns through extraction when OpenClaw resets a session.

focusedListRecallEnabled.description: Enable focused list evidence recall for count, relation, and recommendation questions.

focusedListRecallMaxChars.description: Character budget for the focused list evidence recall section.

focusedListRecallMaxResults.description: Maximum recalled items for focused list evidence.

focusedListRecallScanWindowTokens.description: Recent-token scan window for focused list evidence.

focusedListRecallScanWindowTurns.description: Recent-turn scan window for focused list evidence.

gatewayAgentId.description: Agent persona ID (from openclaw.json agents.list[]) whose model chain to use for extraction, consolidation, and summarization. Required when modelSource is 'gateway'. Falls back to agents.defaults.model if empty.

graphAssistInFullModeEnabled.description: Run bounded graph expansion during full recall mode when seed results exist.

graphAssistMinSeedResults.description: Minimum seed recall results required before full-mode graph assist runs.

graphAssistShadowEvalEnabled.description: In full mode, compute graph assist for comparison telemetry and snapshots but keep recall output baseline-identical.

graphEdgeCacheIncrementalEnabled.description: Push single-writer graph-edge appends into the warm edge cache in place (size-revalidated for cross-process coherence) instead of nulling and re-reading the edge file on every write. Set false to restore the pre-#1904 null-on-every-write behavior.

graphEdgeDecayCadenceMs.description: Cadence in milliseconds for the graph-edge decay cron. Default 7 days. Sub-day cadences map to a daily cron expression.

graphEdgeDecayEnabled.description: Enable the periodic graph-edge confidence decay maintenance job. Opt-in.

graphEdgeDecayFloor.description: Floor confidence will not decay below. Default 0.1.

graphEdgeDecayPerWindow.description: Per-window confidence drop applied during decay. Default 0.1.

graphEdgeDecayVisibilityThreshold.description: Confidence threshold used by the decay telemetry counter for low-visibility edges. Default 0.2.

graphEdgeDecayWindowMs.description: Decay window in milliseconds passed to decayEdgeConfidence. Default 90 days.

graphExpandedIntentEnabled.description: Escalate broader causal/timeline phrasing into graph_mode planning.

enabled.description: Penalize graph-expanded results that rely on invalid intermediate memories.

invalidNodePenalty.description: Multiplicative penalty applied once per invalid intermediate memory.

includePathInProvenance.description: Include graph path node ids in recall provenance when path scoring is enabled.

graphExpansionActivationWeight.description: Blend weight for graph activation when scoring expanded results (0-1). Higher values favor graph activation over seed QMD score.

graphExpansionBlendMax.description: Upper clamp bound for blended graph-expanded recall scores (0-1).

graphExpansionBlendMin.description: Lower clamp bound for blended graph-expanded recall scores (0-1).

graphLateralInhibitionBeta.description: Inhibition strength (0-1). Higher values suppress weaker nodes more aggressively

graphLateralInhibitionEnabled.description: Synapse-inspired lateral inhibition to suppress hub-node dominance in graph retrieval

graphLateralInhibitionTopM.description: Number of top competing nodes considered for lateral inhibition

graphRecallColdMirrorCollection.description: QMD collection name for cold-mirror graph recall results.

graphRecallColdMirrorMinAgeDays.description: Minimum age in days for a memory to qualify for cold-mirror storage.

graphRecallDampingFactor.description: PageRank-style damping factor for graph activation propagation.

graphRecallEnableDebug.description: Enable verbose debug output for graph recall operations.

graphRecallEnableTrace.description: Enable detailed graph recall trace logging for debugging.

graphRecallEnabled.description: Enable graph recall planner mode (`graph_mode`). Requires multiGraphMemoryEnabled. Default false.

graphRecallEntityHintMax.description: Maximum number of entity hints added per graph recall result.

graphRecallEntityHintMaxChars.description: Maximum characters per entity hint added during graph recall.

graphRecallEntityHintsEnabled.description: Inject entity hint summaries alongside graph-recalled memories.

graphRecallEntityPriorBoost.description: Score boost applied to nodes with strong entity priors.

graphRecallExpansionScoreThreshold.description: Minimum blended score required to include a graph-expanded node in results.

graphRecallExplainEdgeLimit.description: Maximum edges described per node in a graph recall explanation.

graphRecallExplainEnabled.description: Append natural-language graph reasoning explanations to recall output.

graphRecallExplainMaxChars.description: Maximum characters per graph recall explanation.

graphRecallExplainMaxPaths.description: Maximum reasoning paths included in a graph recall explanation.

graphRecallExplainToolEnabled.description: Expose a graph explain tool to agents during graph recall.

graphRecallMaxExpandedNodes.description: Maximum total nodes visited during graph recall expansion.

graphRecallMaxExpansions.description: Maximum number of expansion hops per graph recall query.

graphRecallMaxPerSeed.description: Maximum graph-expanded results per seed node.

graphRecallMaxSeedNodes.description: Maximum number of seed nodes selected for graph recall expansion.

graphRecallMaxTrailPerNode.description: Maximum trail length followed per node during graph traversal.

graphRecallMinEdgeWeight.description: Minimum edge weight to follow during graph recall traversal.

graphRecallMinSeedScore.description: Minimum QMD score for a memory to qualify as a graph recall seed.

graphRecallPreferHubSeeds.description: Prefer high-degree hub nodes as graph recall seeds.

graphRecallRecencyHalfLifeDays.description: Half-life in days for recency decay applied to graph-expanded nodes.

graphRecallShadowEnabled.description: Run graph recall in shadow mode - evaluate but do not add results.

graphRecallShadowSampleRate.description: Fraction of turns evaluated in shadow mode (0-1).

graphRecallSnapshotDir.description: Directory for graph recall snapshot files (defaults to {memoryDir}/state/graph).

graphRecallSnapshotEnabled.description: Write graph recall snapshots for offline analysis.

graphRecallStoreColdMirror.description: Store cold-path graph recall results in a secondary QMD collection.

graphRecallUseEntityPriors.description: Boost seed nodes using entity prior scores during graph recall.

graphTraversalConfidenceFloor.description: minimum edge confidence required for traversal during spreading activation. Edges below this floor are pruned and contribute neither activation nor downstream neighbors. Legacy edges without a confidence field are treated as 1.0. Range 0-1. Default 0.2.

graphTraversalPageRankIterations.description: number of PageRank-style refinement iterations applied on top of the BFS spreading-activation scores. Each iteration redistributes a node's confidence-weighted activation along its outgoing edges. Set to 0 to disable refinement and use raw BFS scores. Default 8.

graphWriteSessionAdjacencyEnabled.description: Write fallback temporal adjacency edges for consecutive extracted memories in the same session.

harmonicRetrievalEnabled.description: Enable harmonic retrieval blending over abstraction nodes and cue anchors, including recall-section assembly and harmonic-search diagnostics.

highSignalPatterns.description: Custom regex patterns for immediate extraction

hostEmbeddingProviderEnabled.description: Prefer OpenClaw host-registered embedding providers for Remnic's semantic fallback and embedded vector backends when the OpenClaw SDK exposes them. Falls back to Remnic's existing embedding provider path on older hosts or provider setup failures.

hostEmbeddingProviderId.description: Optional OpenClaw embedding provider adapter id to use. Leave unset for automatic selection from OpenClaw's memory/generic embedding provider registry.

hostEmbeddingProviderModel.description: Optional embedding model id passed to the selected OpenClaw host embedding provider.

hourlySummariesExtendedEnabled.description: Enable structured hourly summaries (topics/decisions/action items/rejections). Default off.

hourlySummariesIncludeSystemMessages.description: Include system messages in extended hourly summaries (use with care).

hourlySummariesIncludeToolStats.description: Include tool usage counts in extended hourly summaries (requires tool usage capture).

hourlySummariesMaxTurnsPerRun.description: Maximum transcript turns to consider per session per hourly summarizer run.

hourlySummaryCronAutoRegister.description: If true, Engram may attempt to auto-register an hourly summary cron job (default off).

identityContinuityEnabled.description: Enable identity continuity workflows (anchor, incidents, audits)

identityEnabled.description: Enable agent identity reflections (appends to workspace IDENTITY.md)

identityInjectionMode.description: Controls when identity continuity context is added to recall assembly

identityMaxInjectChars.description: Maximum characters allowed for identity continuity context

initGateTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time Remnic waits for cold-start initialization during recall; also registered as the OpenClaw before_prompt_build hook timeout on SDKs that support per-hook options.

injectQuestions.description: Include the most relevant open question in generated memory context

inlineSourceAttributionEnabled.description: Enable inline source attribution markers on persisted facts for downstream provenance tracking.

inlineSourceAttributionFormat.description: Template used when inline source attribution is enabled.

inlineSourceAttributionFormatHistory.description: Prior inline citation templates still recognized during merge after a format change.

intentRoutingBoost.description: Maximum score boost applied for intent-compatible memory matches.

intentRoutingEnabled.description: Attach intent metadata to memories and boost compatible memories at recall.

ircEnabled.description: Enable Inductive Rule Consolidation (IRC) subsystem (default on).

ircIncludeCorrections.description: Include corrections when building IRC rules (default on).

ircMaxPreferences.description: Maximum number of preferences to include in IRC rules.

ircMinConfidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for an IRC rule to be included (0-1).

judgeTrainingDir.description: Override directory for judge training-pair collection. Empty string uses the default (~/.remnic/judge-training). Only consulted when collectJudgeTrainingPairs is true.

knowledgeIndexEnabled.description: Inject a compact Knowledge Index of top entities into every recall

knowledgeIndexMaxChars.description: Hard character cap for the Knowledge Index section

knowledgeIndexMaxEntities.description: Max entities included in the Knowledge Index

lanceDbPath.description: Directory path for LanceDB storage (when searchBackend=lancedb)

lanceEmbeddingDimension.description: Embedding vector dimension for LanceDB (when searchBackend=lancedb)

lancedbEnabled.description: Enable LanceDB as a supplemental search backend.

lcmArchiveRetentionDays.description: Days to retain archived LCM summaries

lcmFreshTailTurns.description: Number of recent turns kept verbatim (not summarized)

lcmLeafBatchSize.description: Number of turns per leaf node in the LCM DAG

lcmMaxDepth.description: Maximum depth of the LCM summary DAG

lcmObserveConcurrency.description: Maximum independent LCM observe jobs to process concurrently.

lcmRecallBudgetShare.description: Fraction of recall budget allocated to LCM compressed history (0-1)

lcmRollupFanIn.description: Number of children per rollup node in the LCM DAG

lcmTelemetryPrefilterEnabled.description: Use deterministic LCM compression for mechanical action/state telemetry without durable-memory cues.

lifecycleArchiveDecayThreshold.description: Decay threshold for lifecycle demotion to archived state semantics.

lifecycleFilterStaleEnabled.description: If enabled, stale lifecycle memories can be filtered from retrieval (wired in PR20D).

lifecycleMetricsEnabled.description: Emit lifecycle metrics snapshots to state/lifecycle-metrics.json when policy is enabled.

lifecyclePolicyEnabled.description: Enable the lifecycle policy engine (hot↔cold tier migration, value scoring, decay). Default true since #686 - flipping enables the year-2 retention story by default. Set to false to opt out.

lifecyclePromoteHeatThreshold.description: Heat threshold for lifecycle promotion to validated/active states.

lifecycleProtectedCategories.description: Categories that lifecycle policy will not auto-archive.

lifecycleStaleDecayThreshold.description: Decay threshold for lifecycle demotion to stale.

llmBridgeClientConfigPath.description: Path to the Hermes loopback-bridge client JSON. Parsed into backgroundGeneration only. Never copied onto openaiBaseUrl.

localLlm400CooldownMs.description: Cooldown duration after tripping local LLM 400 threshold (ms).

localLlm400TripThreshold.description: Consecutive 400 responses before local LLM enters temporary cooldown.

localLlmApiKey.description: Optional API key for authenticated OpenAI-compatible local endpoints

localLlmApiKeyEnv.description: Optional environment variable name for a local LLM API key. A missing variable leaves local auth unset so read-only CLI commands can still load config.

localLlmAuthHeader.description: If false, do not send Authorization header even when localLlmApiKey is set

localLlmDisableThinking.description: When true (default), suppress thinking on supported local backends for extraction and other terse structured operations. `localLlmThinkingThresholdChars` re-enables thinking for short extractions. Consolidation and the fast tier are unaffected.

localLlmThinkingThresholdChars.description: Enable thinking for local extraction when the transcript is shorter than this many characters. Set to 0 to keep thinking suppressed for every extraction. Consolidation is unaffected.

localLlmEnabled.description: Enable local LLM for extraction and summarization (e.g., LM Studio, Ollama)

localLlmFallback.description: Legacy alias for taskLlmFallback. Use the gateway/task LLM chain when the local LLM path fails or is unavailable.

localLlmFastEnabled.description: Enable a separate smaller/faster local LLM for quick operations (rerank, entity_summary, tmt_summary, compression_guideline).

localLlmFastModel.description: Model ID for fast-tier local LLM operations. Empty string uses the primary localLlmModel.

localLlmFastTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for fast-tier local LLM requests (ms). Lower than primary since fast ops should complete quickly.

localLlmFastUrl.description: Endpoint for the fast-tier local LLM. Defaults to the same endpoint as localLlmUrl when not set.

localLlmHeaders.description: Optional additional headers for local/compatible endpoint requests

localLlmHomeDir.description: Optional home directory override for local LLM helpers (LM Studio settings + CLI PATH resolution).

localLlmMaxContext.description: Override the detected context window for local LLM. Set to 32768 if your LLM server defaults to 32K context despite the model supporting 128K.

localLlmModel.description: Model name for local LLM requests

localLlmReasoningEffort.description: Ollama-backend thinking suppression: reasoning_effort injected for thinking-suppressed operations (Ollama ignores chat_template_kwargs). Empty string disables injection.

localLlmRetry5xxCount.description: Number of retry attempts for local LLM 5xx responses.

localLlmRetryBackoffMs.description: Base backoff delay between local LLM retries (ms).

localLlmTimeoutMs.description: Hard timeout for local LLM requests (ms). Legacy alias for taskLlmTimeoutMs on the gateway/task chain when that key is absent.

taskLlmTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the gateway/task LLM chain (ms). In gateway mode this is the primary extraction timeout. localLlmTimeoutMs is a legacy alias when this key is absent.

taskLlmFallback.description: When the local LLM path fails or is unavailable, use the gateway/task LLM chain. localLlmFallback is a legacy alias when this key is absent.

localLlmUrl.description: URL for local LLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint

localLmsBinDir.description: Optional bin directory prepended to PATH for LMS CLI execution.

localLmsCliPath.description: Optional absolute path to LMS CLI binary. Preferred over auto-detected locations.

maintenanceIncludeBranchNamespaces.description: Include dynamic branch namespaces from the namespace catalog in background maintenance fanout. Defaults off to avoid high-cardinality branch churn.

maintenanceIncludeProjectNamespaces.description: Include dynamic project namespaces from the namespace catalog in background maintenance fanout.

maintenanceIncludeTeamProjectNamespaces.description: Include dynamic team-project namespaces from the namespace catalog in background maintenance fanout.

maintenanceMaxNamespacesPerCycle.description: Maximum namespaces a single maintenance job cycle may process. Default and shared namespaces keep priority inside this budget.

maintenanceNamespaceFanoutEnabled.description: When namespaces are enabled, let background maintenance enumerate live catalog namespaces in addition to configured default/shared/policy namespaces.

maintenanceNamespaceLockStaleMs.description: Stale threshold for per-job/per-namespace maintenance locks under state/maintenance-locks/.

maxCompressionTokensPerHour.description: Hourly token budget for compression actions/guideline generation (0 disables budgeted compression work).

maxEntityGraphEdgesPerMemory.description: Maximum entity graph edges written per memory write. Default 10.

maxGraphTraversalSteps.description: Maximum BFS hops during spreading activation. Default 3.

maxProactiveQuestionsPerExtraction.description: Maximum proactive self-questions generated per extraction pass (0 disables question generation).

maxSummaryCount.description: Maximum number of summaries to include

meilisearchAutoIndex.description: Automatically push local memory docs to Meilisearch on update (when searchBackend=meilisearch)

meilisearchEnabled.description: Enable Meilisearch as a supplemental search backend.

meilisearchTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for Meilisearch requests (when searchBackend=meilisearch)

memoryBoxesEnabled.description: Enable Memory Boxes (v8.0 Phase 2A). Groups memories into topic-bounded windows. Disabled by default.

memoryExtensionsEnabled.description: Whether third-party memory extensions are discovered and included in consolidation instructions.

memoryExtensionsRoot.description: Root directory for memory extensions. Empty string derives from memoryDir (go up to Remnic home and append memory_extensions).

memoryLifecycleLedgerCompactBytes.description: Auto-compact state/memory-lifecycle-ledger.jsonl when it exceeds this many bytes, triggered off the debounced maintenance path. Set 0 to disable. Default 64MB.

memoryLifecycleLedgerCompactMinIntervalM.description: Minimum interval between auto-compactions of the lifecycle ledger. Default 6 hours.

memoryLinkingEnabled.description: Enable automatic memory linking to build knowledge graph

offlineSyncExcludes.description: Extra offline-sync push-side exclude globs (relative to memoryDir). Additive to built-in node-local state excludes (state/*.sqlite, state/*.sqlite-*, state/index_tags.json, state/entity-mention-index.json, state/memory-governance/runs/**).

memoryOsPreset.description: Optional named preset that seeds Engram's advanced config surface before explicit per-setting settings are applied. `research` is accepted as a backward-compatible alias for `research-max`.

memoryPoisoningDefenseEnabled.description: Enable deterministic provenance trust scoring for trust-zone records as the first poisoning-defense surface.

memoryInjectionDefenseMode.description: Packaged memory-injection defense; custom keeps originAuthorityEnabled and injectionScreenEnabled as set.

originAuthorityEnabled.description: Fence recall-rendered content from untrusted origins as data-only. Origin metadata is always recorded; this flag gates only the recall-time fence.

injectionScreenEnabled.description: Screen candidate facts with deterministic injection rules and queue findings for review.

untrustedOrigins.description: Origin classes that receive the recall authority fence.

memoryReconstructionEnabled.description: E-Mem-inspired memory reconstruction: targeted secondary retrieval for entity references lacking context in recall

memoryReconstructionMaxExpansions.description: Maximum number of entity expansions per recall cycle

memoryRedTeamBenchEnabled.description: Enable operator-facing memory red-team benchmark packs and status accounting for poisoning-defense regression suites.

memoryUtilityLearningEnabled.description: Enable utility-learning telemetry storage so later slices can learn promotion and ranking weights from downstream outcomes.

messagePartsEnabled.description: Opt in to structured LCM message-part capture for tool calls, file references, patches, and reasoning markers.

messagePartsRecallMaxResults.description: Maximum structured message-part matches to include in recall when messagePartsEnabled is true.

modelSource.description: LLM source: 'gateway' delegates to a gateway agent's model chain (agents.list[]); 'plugin' uses Engram's own openai/localLlm config.

multiGraphMemoryEnabled.description: Enable multi-graph memory (entity, time, causal edges). Default false.

namespaceCatalogEnabled.description: Enable the rebuildable namespace catalog when namespaces are enabled. Default true.

namespacesCatalogCompactBytes.description: Size (bytes) at which a namespace-catalog touch auto-compacts <memoryDir>/state/namespaces.jsonl. The append-only log is folded (last-record-wins; every namespace row preserved) and atomically rewritten once it exceeds this size. Default 16777216 (16 MB); 0 disables auto-compaction.

namespacesCatalogReadTouchCoalesceMs.description: Coalescing window (ms) for repeated pure-timestamp read touches on an already-known namespace. Buffered per (namespace, kind) and flushed once per window; observable touches (first sight, provenance/field change) always flush immediately. Default 60000; 0 disables read coalescing.

namespacesCatalogTouchStateWrites.description: Whether pure state-file writes (state/buffer.json, ledgers, indexes) touch the namespace catalog. State files are not namespace memory data, so by default their writes do not record a catalog touch. Set true to restore the pre-#1903 behavior. Default false.

namespacesCatalogWriteTouchCoalesceMs.description: Coalescing window (ms) for repeated pure-timestamp write touches on an already-known namespace. Mirrors namespacesCatalogReadTouchCoalesceMs for markWrite/lastWriteAt. Default 1000; 0 disables write coalescing.

nativeKnowledge.description: Optional: search curated workspace markdown files directly during recall without converting them into durable memory files.

enabled.description: Master switch for curated workspace file recall.

includeFiles.description: Workspace-relative curated markdown files to scan for native knowledge recall.

maxChunkChars.description: Maximum chunk size per native knowledge section before it is split.

maxResults.description: Maximum native knowledge chunks to add to recall.

maxChars.description: Maximum total characters to add from native knowledge recall.

stateDir.description: Memory-relative directory used for backend-agnostic native knowledge sync state.

openclawWorkspace.description: Optional adapter for OpenClaw workspace artifacts such as bootstrap docs, handoffs, daily summaries, and automation notes.

enabled.description: Enable the OpenClaw workspace native-knowledge adapter.

bootstrapFiles.description: Workspace-relative bootstrap docs treated as high-confidence native knowledge.

handoffGlobs.description: Glob patterns (relative to workspaceDir) used to discover handoff notes.

dailySummaryGlobs.description: Glob patterns (relative to workspaceDir) used to discover daily summary notes.

automationNoteGlobs.description: Optional glob patterns for automation-written status or operating notes.

workspaceDocGlobs.description: Optional glob patterns for other explicitly allowlisted workspace docs.

excludeGlobs.description: Additional glob patterns appended to the built-in workspace safety excludes.

sharedSafeGlobs.description: Optional glob patterns that should be tagged as shared-safe when no explicit privacy class is present.

obsidianVaults.description: Optional Obsidian vault adapters to sync into backend-agnostic native knowledge records.

id.description: Stable vault identifier used in synced note metadata.

rootDir.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault root.

includeGlobs.description: Glob patterns (relative to the vault root) that are eligible for sync.

namespace.description: Default namespace assigned to records from this vault.

privacyClass.description: Operator-defined privacy class preserved on synced records.

folderRules.description: Optional per-folder overrides for namespace or privacy classification.

pathPrefix.description: Vault-relative folder prefix that activates the override.

dailyNotePatterns.description: Filename patterns used to derive daily-note dates (for example `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY/MM/DD`).

materializeBacklinks.description: If true, compute backlinks from wikilink targets for recall hints and explainability.

negativeExamplesEnabled.description: Enable negative examples (track retrieved-but-not-useful memories) and apply a small ranking penalty.

negativeExamplesPenaltyCap.description: Maximum ranking penalty applied from negative examples.

negativeExamplesPenaltyPerHit.description: Ranking penalty per negative example hit (keep small; QMD scores are ~0-1).

nightlyGovernanceCronAutoRegister.description: If true, Engram may attempt to auto-register the nightly governance cron job (default off).

noveltyAddThreshold.description: novelty score at or above this value is ADD (skip semantic/LLM dedup). Keep well above noveltyNoopThreshold so UNCERTAIN stays wide.

noveltyGateEnabled.description: enable the write-path embedding-density novelty gate. Off by default. When off the persist path is unchanged.

noveltyNoopThreshold.description: novelty score at or below this value is NOOP (drop before semantic dedup; does not touch contentHashIndex).

objectiveStateMemoryEnabled.description: Enable Engram's objective-state memory foundation for normalized world/tool state snapshots.

objectiveStateRecallEnabled.description: Add recall-relevant objective-state snapshots to recall context.

objectiveStateSnapshotWritesEnabled.description: Allow writing typed objective-state snapshots to the objective-state store.

objectiveStateStoreDir.description: Override the objective-state memory directory (defaults to {memoryDir}/state/objective-state).

openaiApiKey.description: Optional OpenAI API key for plugin mode (or set OPENAI_API_KEY env var). Ignored by default gateway-mode installs; in plugin mode, Remnic may send conversation and memory content to OpenAI or the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint for extraction, consolidation, summarization, and embeddings.

openaiBaseUrl.description: Set the OpenAI API base URL for OpenAI-compatible providers (Scryr, Together, OpenRouter, etc.)

openclawChannelEnvelopeCleaningEnabled.description: Use OpenClaw's canonical chat-channel envelope prefixes when the SDK exposes plugin-sdk/chat-channel-ids, while keeping the legacy OpenClaw-only cleaner on older hosts.

openclawFlushPlanProcessingEnabled.description: Process OpenClaw's append-only Remnic flush-plan file through Remnic extraction and clear processed content. Disable this if a future OpenClaw release owns flush-plan consumption and cleanup natively.

openclawMessageReceivedCaptureEnabled.description: Capture OpenClaw message_received hook content into transcripts when that hook is emitted by the host. Older OpenClaw versions that never emit the hook continue through agent_end capture.

openclawReplyMetadataCaptureEnabled.description: Persist bounded OpenClaw messageId, threadId, replyToId, replyToBody, and replyToSender fields in transcript metadata when available.

openclawReplyMetadataExtractionHintsEnab.description: When true, prepend bounded quoted-reply context to user turns before Remnic extraction. Leave false to store reply metadata without changing extraction behavior.

openclawToolSnippetMaxChars.description: Maximum snippet size returned by the OpenClaw memory tool adapters.

openclawToolsEnabled.description: Register the OpenClaw memory.search and memory.get tool adapters.

operatorAwareConsolidationEnabled.description: Opt in to operator-aware consolidation instructions so the LLM returns structured {operator, output} JSON and SPLIT/MERGE/UPDATE is recorded on derived_via. When disabled (default), derived_via still populates via the cluster-shape heuristic.

oramaDbPath.description: Directory path for Orama persistence files (when searchBackend=orama)

oramaEmbeddingDimension.description: Embedding vector dimension for Orama (when searchBackend=orama)

oramaCjkSegmentation.description: Segment space-free scripts (CJK/Thai) into character n-grams in the Orama lexical index. Default true; false restores the stock English-only tokenizer.

oramaEnabled.description: Enable Orama as a supplemental search backend.

parallelAgentWeights.description: Score weights per retrieval agent source applied during result merge.

parallelMaxResultsPerAgent.description: Maximum results fetched per agent before merge.

parallelRetrievalEnabled.description: Enable three-agent parallel retrieval (DirectFact + Contextual + Temporal). Zero additional LLM cost. Default false.

patternReinforcementCadenceMs.description: Minimum interval (ms) between pattern-reinforcement runs. Default 7 days. Set to 0 to disable cadence gating (manual / test invocation).

patternReinforcementCategories.description: Memory categories the pattern-reinforcement job considers. Skips procedural memories so it stays disjoint from procedural mining. Default: preference, fact, decision.

patternReinforcementEnabled.description: Run the pattern-reinforcement maintenance job: cluster duplicate non-procedural memories by normalized content, promote the most-recent member to canonical, and supersede the older duplicates. Off by default until bench validation lands.

patternReinforcementMinCount.description: Minimum cluster size before pattern reinforcement promotes a canonical and supersedes duplicates. Default 3.

peerProfileReasonerEnabled.description: Enable the async peer profile reasoner. Runs after semantic consolidation in the REM phase and updates per-peer profile.md files with provenance-tagged field updates derived from the peer's interaction log. Default off (opt-in).

peerProfileReasonerMaxFieldsPerRun.description: Hard cap on the total number of profile fields the reasoner will apply across all peers in a single run. Set to 0 to disable applying any fields.

peerProfileReasonerMinInteractions.description: Minimum new interaction-log entries a peer must accumulate since the previous reasoner run before being processed again. Set to 0 to consider every peer on every run.

peerProfileReasonerModel.description: Model identifier used by the peer profile reasoner. 'auto' inherits the gateway's primary chain (recommended). Logged for telemetry only - actual dispatch routes through the same FallbackLlmClient used by semantic consolidation.
