peerProfileRecallEnabled.description: When true, add the active peer's profile fields to the recall context as a '## Peer Profile' section. Requires the session's peer ID to be registered before recall. Default off (opt-in).

peerProfileRecallMaxFields.description: Maximum number of peer profile fields to add per recall call. Only the most-recently-updated N fields are included. Set to 0 to disable field inclusion even when peerProfileRecallEnabled is true.

principalFromSessionKeyMode.description: How to derive principal identity from sessionKey.

principalFromSessionKeyRules.description: Rules for resolving principal from sessionKey (ordered).

proactiveExtractionCategoryAllowlist.description: Optional memory categories allowed from proactive second-pass writes. When omitted, proactive writes can emit any standard memory category.

proactiveExtractionEnabled.description: Enable proactive self-questioning extraction second-pass (v8.3, default off).

proactiveExtractionMaxTokens.description: Token budget for each proactive extraction sub-call (0 disables the proactive second pass).

proactiveExtractionSkipWhenLocalLlmBusy.description: Skip the optional proactive extraction second pass when the local LLM background lane is already busy, instead of queueing behind an in-flight extraction and losing its shorter deadline. Set false to always attempt the second pass.

proactiveExtractionTimeoutMs.description: Hard timeout in milliseconds for proactive self-question generation and answer synthesis (0 disables the proactive second pass).

enabled.description: Master gate for procedural memory: extraction, recall boost, and mining. Default-on since ; set to `false` to opt out.

minOccurrences.description: Minimum clustered trajectory occurrences before emitting a candidate procedure (0 disables mining).

successFloor.description: Minimum success-rate floor (from trajectory outcomes) for miner promotion.

autoPromoteOccurrences.description: When auto-promotion is enabled, minimum occurrence count to move pending_review procedures to active (0 disables auto-promotion by count).

autoPromoteEnabled.description: When true, miner may auto-promote trusted procedures to active after autoPromoteOccurrences.

lookbackDays.description: Trajectory lookback window for procedural mining.

recallMaxProcedures.description: Maximum procedure memories to add on task-initiation recall.

proceduralMiningCronAutoRegister.description: When true, installer may register the nightly procedural mining cron job.

enabled.description: Project active procedure memories into host-native `skills/<slug>/SKILL.md` bundles during Codex materialization. Off by default; the CLI export/import commands work regardless of this gate.

maxSkills.description: Maximum projected skill bundles. 0 disables projection entirely.

enabled.description: Master gate for the procedure library-health maintenance job: merge near-duplicate active procedures, flag stale-tool procedures, retire failure-dominant or idle ones. Shadow-first: runs without apply write nothing.

retireIdleDays.description: Days without an access signal (and with zero recorded outcomes) before an active procedure is retired as idle. 0 disables idle-based retirement.

retireMinOutcomes.description: Minimum mw_fail count before failure-dominant retirement is considered.

retireFailRatio.description: mw_fail must exceed mw_success times this ratio for failure-dominant retirement.

mergeEnabled.description: Whether duplicate-cluster merging runs within the maintenance gate.

driftDetection.description: Preference drift detection: classify aging `preference` memories as corroborated / stale / drifted, review-gate drifted ones, and optionally damp stale ones at recall.

enabled.description: Master switch for drift classification and its apply mode. Default off.

minAgeDays.description: A preference younger than this many days is never a scan candidate.

lookbackDays.description: Evidence-gathering window, in days back from the run instant, using [start, end) bounds.

maxCandidatesPerRun.description: Cap on preferences classified per run. Set to 0 to disable the scan.

recallDamping.description: When true, recall multiplies the rank score of `driftState: stale` preference memories by stalePenalty. Default off; when off, recall ordering is byte-identical to pre-#2371.

stalePenalty.description: Multiplier applied to stale preferences in (0, 1]. Set to 1 to disable the effect without flipping recallDamping.

annotateAfterDays.description: Annotate an injected preference whose last corroboration is older than this many days. 0 disables annotation.

deepRecall.description: Budgeted deep-recall surface: REFINE/EXPAND/STOP retrieval over the cue-anchor graph, exposed only on the deep surfaces (MCP deep_recall tool, POST /engram|remnic/v1/recall/deep, remnic engram deep-recall CLI). Never runs on the recall hot path.

enabled.description: Master switch for the deep-recall surface. Default off.

maxSteps.description: Policy iterations; 0 disables the loop (seed-only retrieval).

maxExpandPerStep.description: Per-step cap on frontier nodes pulled into the working set. 0 honors EXPAND but selects nothing.

maxResults.description: Final working-set cap returned to the caller. 0 returns an empty entry list.

stepTimeoutMs.description: Per policy-call timeout in ms; 0 = none.

totalTimeoutMs.description: Whole-invocation wall-clock timeout in ms; 0 = none.

recallNavigation.description: Expand or traverse a served memory without a new search.

enabled.description: Master switch. Default on.

windowSnapshots.description: Recent recall snapshots that authorize an id.

enabled.description: Master switch. Default off; conservative pins off.

seedGraduation.description: Graduate pending_review seeds (#2974). Off by default.

enabled.description: Master gate for extraction-pipeline liveness reporting. When false, /health, doctor, and stats never report the pipeline degraded. Default on.

staleWindowMs.description: How stale the last-successful-extraction watermark may get (ms) before a non-empty buffer flags the pipeline degraded. Default 86400000 (24h).

replicaPeers.description: Replica divergence detection. Poll each configured peer's authenticated /health corpus watermark and flag per-namespace drift (file-count delta, watermark age delta, digest mismatch). Detection only; reconciliation is Disabled by default.

enabled.description: Master gate. When false (default) no peers are polled and the daemon behaves exactly as before.

peers.description: Peer Remnic agent-access HTTP endpoints to poll for corpus watermarks.

url.description: Base URL of the peer's agent-access HTTP server (http or https). Supports ${ENV_VAR} expansion.

token.description: Bearer token for the peer's authenticated /health. A literal string (supports ${ENV_VAR} expansion) or an OpenClaw SecretRef object resolved at poll time like agentAccessHttp.authToken. Never logged.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often each peer is re-polled (stale-while-revalidate TTL), in ms. Finite integer >= 1; string forms are coerced and fractional/non-positive values are rejected at parse time. Default 300000 (5 min).

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-peer HTTP request timeout, in ms. Finite integer >= 1. Default 10000 (10s).

maxFileCountDelta.description: Per-namespace memory-file-count difference beyond which a peer is flagged diverged. 0 flags any difference. Default 100.

maxWatermarkAgeDeltaMs.description: Per-namespace newest-write timestamp gap (ms) beyond which a peer is flagged diverged. 0 flags any gap. Default 900000 (15 min).

profilingEnabled.description: If true, enable performance profiling for recall and extraction pipelines. Profiling data is stored locally in the profiling storage directory.

profilingMaxTraces.description: Maximum number of profiling trace files to retain. Oldest traces are pruned when this limit is exceeded.

profilingStorageDir.description: Directory path for storing profiling trace files. Defaults to <memoryDir>/profiling if empty.

projectionRebuildEnabled.description: Schedule rebuilds of the memory projection. Default true; manual rebuild remains available.

projectionRebuildIntervalMs.description: Cadence (ms) for the scheduled memory-projection rebuild. Finite integer, minimum 60000; string forms are coerced and invalid or sub-minimum values are rejected at parse time.

promotionByOutcomeEnabled.description: Enable outcome-aware promotion controls that consume learned utility signals when later rollout slices activate them.

minAccessCount.description: Minimum accessCount before an agent-subject memory qualifies as reuse-signaled for promotion-candidates.

provenance.description: Claim-level provenance spans. When enabled, extracted facts carry verbatim source-utterance excerpts plus a coarse strength tag (verified/unverified/none) consumed by the faithfulness gate, correction UX, tombstone matching, and TrustScore.

enabled.description: Emit provenance spans on new extractions. Off = pre-feature extraction prompt/output, byte-identical. Default: true (applied in code; no schema default so the REMNIC_/ENGRAM_ env override fires when the key is omitted).

maxQuoteChars.description: Maximum characters stored per quote; longer quotes truncate at a word boundary with an ellipsis marker. Never stores the whole turn.

requireSpans.description: When true, facts whose quote cannot be located are routed to pending_review instead of active. Stays false until #1576 lands and the bench shows the gate is safe.

qmdAutoEmbedEnabled.description: If true, background QMD maintenance also runs embed on a throttled cadence.

qmdAutoUpgradeCheckIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval between QMD auto-upgrade checks

qmdAutoUpgradeEnabled.description: Opt-in auto-upgrade for PATH/fallback QMD installs

qmdCandidateLimit.description: Optional candidate limit forwarded to supported QMD query paths

qmdChunkStrategy.description: QMD chunk strategy forwarded when the installed QMD supports it

qmdColdCollection.description: Secondary QMD collection name used for cold-tier fallback recall

qmdColdMaxResults.description: Max cold-tier QMD results considered before final recall cap

qmdColdTierEnabled.description: Enable cold-tier QMD recall from a secondary collection when hot recall misses

wikiMergeIntoRecall.description: Reserved safety gate. External wiki collections remain on-demand only; true is not supported.

qmdDaemonEnabled.description: Prefer the shared QMD MCP session for faster searches when available.

qmdDaemonRecheckIntervalMs.description: Re-probe interval when daemon is down (ms)

qmdDaemonTimeoutMs.description: Per-call timeout (ms) for QMD daemon searches. Default 8000; raise (e.g. 20000) to give CPU-only HyDE queries more headroom before the daemon call times out.

qmdDaemonUrl.description: Legacy compatibility setting retained for QMD daemon configuration.

qmdEmbedMinIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval between background QMD embed runs (ms).

qmdExplainEnabled.description: Request QMD explain traces for recall debugging when supported.

qmdForceCpu.description: Set QMD_FORCE_CPU=1 for QMD child processes to bypass GPU probing and run predictably on CPU

qmdGpuBackend.description: Optional QMD_LLAMA_GPU override for QMD child processes

qmdIndexName.description: Optional QMD named index forwarded as qmd --index <name> when supported. Leave unset during upgrades unless existing QMD data already lives in that named index.

qmdIntentHintsEnabled.description: Pass Engram's inferred recall intent into QMD unified search when supported.

qmdMaintenanceDebounceMs.description: Debounce window for background QMD maintenance updates (ms).

qmdMaintenanceEnabled.description: Enable debounced background QMD maintenance instead of immediate updates on extraction.

qmdEmbeddingBacklogThreshold.description: Pending-embedding count above which QMD health reports degraded. Set to 0 to disable backlog degradation.

qmdPath.description: Optional absolute path to qmd binary (bypasses PATH/fallback discovery)

qmdQueryRerankEnabled.description: When false, ask supported QMD versions to skip the built-in rerank step

qmdRecallCacheMaxEntries.description: Maximum in-memory rendered QMD recall cache entries before oldest eviction.

qmdRecallCacheStaleTtlMs.description: Maximum stale TTL in ms for rendered QMD recall cache fallbacks.

qmdRecallCacheTtlMs.description: Fresh TTL in ms for rendered QMD recall enrichment cache entries.

qmdSearchStrategy.description: Daemon search plan. 'hybrid' (default) runs lex+vec+hyde for best recall; 'lex-vec' drops the expensive HyDE generate leg; 'lex' is BM25-only (fastest). Lower tiers trade recall for latency on CPU-only models. Default preserves existing behavior.

qmdSubprocessStrategy.description: Command for the QMD CLI subprocess fallback, used only when the daemon is unavailable. 'query' (default) keeps LLM query expansion + rerank; 'search' is BM25-only and faster on very large collections but loses expansion/rerank. Default preserves existing behavior.

qmdSupportedVersion.description: Highest QMD version this Remnic build will auto-install

qmdTierAutoBackfillEnabled.description: Allow automated cold-tier backfill jobs to repair parity gaps

qmdTierDemotionMinAgeDays.description: Minimum hot-memory age in days before tier demotion is eligible

qmdTierDemotionValueThreshold.description: Value-score threshold at or below which hot memories are eligible for cold demotion

qmdTierMigrationEnabled.description: Enable value-aware migration between hot and cold QMD tiers

qmdTierParityGraphEnabled.description: Apply graph-assist parity checks across hot and cold retrieval tiers

qmdTierParityHiMemEnabled.description: Apply HiMem episode/note parity checks across hot and cold retrieval tiers

qmdTierPromotionValueThreshold.description: Value-score threshold at or above which cold memories are eligible for hot promotion

qmdUpdateMinIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval between QMD update executions (ms). Useful because current QMD update runs globally across collections.

qmdUpdateTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for QMD update command (ms). Increase if your index grows and updates exceed 30s.

quarantinePromotionEnabled.description: Reserve future promotion flows from quarantine into higher-trust zones.

queryAwareIndexingEnabled.description: Enable temporal and tag indexes (v8.1). Maintains state/index_time.json and state/index_tags.json for fast prefiltering. At recall time, temporal queries and #tag tokens receive a small score boost from the index. Disabled by default.

queryAwareIndexingMaxCandidates.description: Max candidate paths returned from index prefilter before scoring (0 = no cap).

queryExpansionEnabled.description: Enable heuristic query expansion for retrieval (no LLM calls).

queryExpansionMaxQueries.description: Max expanded queries to run (including the original prompt).

queryExpansionMinTokenLen.description: Minimum token length to include in heuristic query expansion.

recallAuditAnomalyDetectionEnabled.description: When true, access surfaces (MCP, HTTP) run the anomaly detector over a tail of the audit trail after each recall and surface flags via logs/metrics. Ships disabled - enable explicitly.

recallAuditAnomalyHighCardinalityLimit.description: Threshold for the high-cardinality-return anomaly flag: number of distinct results returned within the window before flagging.

recallAuditAnomalyNamespaceWalkLimit.description: Threshold for the namespace-walk anomaly flag: number of distinct namespaces queried within the window before flagging.

recallAuditAnomalyRapidFireLimit.description: Threshold for the rapid-fire anomaly flag: number of recall requests within the window before flagging.

recallAuditAnomalyRepeatQueryLimit.description: Threshold for the repeat-query anomaly flag: number of identical queries within the window before flagging.

recallAuditAnomalyWindowMs.description: Rolling window (ms) over which audit entries are analyzed by the anomaly detector. Default 5 minutes.

recallBudgetChars.description: Hard character headroom for total recall context. Defaults to maxMemoryTokens * 4 for Latin-script capacity; recall assembly also enforces maxMemoryTokens with the shared script-aware estimator.

recallProfileMaxRatio.description: Maximum fraction of the total recall budget available to the behavioral profile. Set to 1 to disable the share cap.

recallStateViews.description: State-aware recall views: on change-intent queries, superseded memories surface as labeled history (current/historical/transition) when their successor is also recalled. Default false keeps recall output byte-identical.

recallStandingBlock.description: Prefix-cache-stable standing memory block (issue #2971): a byte-stable index over pinned/high-value memories placed before per-turn recall so the LLM prefix cache survives across turns. The builder refuses clock/date/counter content at build time. Default false keeps recall output byte-identical; recall-path injection lands in a later wiring slice.

standingBlockFreshDays.description: Days a memory stays in the standing block's full-text fresh band before it compresses to a recognition hook.

standingBlockMaxChars.description: Hard character budget for the standing memory block. Pinned lines that cannot fit refuse the build rather than truncate.

recallRecognitionTier.description: Full-index recognition tier (issue #2975): small namespaces recall by recognizing against the whole compact index instead of vector search; absent or oversized indexes fall back to vector search deterministically. Default false keeps recall byte-identical; recall-path wiring lands in a later slice.

recognitionIndexMaxEntries.description: Inclusive entry threshold for the full-index recognition tier; larger indexes route to vector search.

recallConfidenceGateEnabled.description: Synapse-inspired confidence gate: skip memory context when top recall score is below threshold

recallConfidenceGateThreshold.description: Minimum top recall score to include memories (0-1). Below this, memories are rejected as too uncertain

recallCoreDeadlineMs.description: Default deadline in ms recorded for core recall sections.

recallCrossNamespaceBudgetEnabled.description: Cross-namespace query-budget limiter. When true, a principal that issues a burst of recalls against namespaces other than their own is throttled once its per-window count crosses the hard limit. Ships disabled.

recallCrossNamespaceBudgetHardLimit.description: Hard threshold for the cross-namespace budget: calls past this count are denied until the window advances.

recallCrossNamespaceBudgetSoftLimit.description: Soft threshold for the cross-namespace budget: calls past this count are flagged but still allowed.

recallCrossNamespaceBudgetWindowMs.description: Rolling window in ms over which cross-namespace reads are counted for the per-principal budget.

recallDirectAnswerAmbiguityMargin.description: If the second-best candidate scores within this ratio of the top, direct-answer defers to hybrid.

recallDirectAnswerEligibleTaxonomyBucket.description: Taxonomy category IDs eligible for direct-answer routing.

recallDirectAnswerEnabled.description: When true, recall runs the direct-answer tier in observation mode: annotates LastRecallSnapshot.tierExplain with which tier would have served the query. Does not short-circuit the QMD path in the current release.

recallDirectAnswerImportanceFloor.description: Minimum calibrated importance score for direct-answer eligibility. Set to 0 to disable the gate.

recallDirectAnswerTokenOverlapFloor.description: Minimum query↔memory token-overlap ratio for direct-answer eligibility. Set to 0 to disable the gate.

recallDisclosureEscalation.description: Disclosure auto-escalation policy. When 'auto', recalls without an explicit caller-supplied disclosure escalate from chunk to section if the top-K confidence falls below recallDisclosureEscalationThreshold. 'raw' is never auto-selected. Default 'manual' preserves pre-#677 behavior.

recallDisclosureEscalationThreshold.description: Top-K confidence threshold (0-1) below which auto-escalation promotes chunk to section. Only consulted when recallDisclosureEscalation is 'auto'. Default 0.5.

recallEnrichmentDeadlineMs.description: Default deadline in ms recorded for enrichment recall sections.

recallGraphDamping.description: PPR damping factor used by the graph retrieval tier.

recallGraphEnabled.description: When true, recall builds a retrieval graph from memory frontmatter and runs Personalized PageRank, merging the result with QMD via MMR. Default false - ships off pending the retrieval-graph bench in

recallGraphIterations.description: Maximum power-iteration rounds for PPR. Higher values trade latency for convergence.

recallGraphTopK.description: Maximum memories returned by the graph retrieval tier before the MMR diversifier runs.

recallHandleSnapshotDepth.description: number of recent per-session recall snapshots searched when resolving a `[m:xxxx]` handle to a memory id. Older-than-N snapshots are not searched; a miss is tagged rather than widening the window.

recallImpressionsRotateBytes.description: Rotate state/recall_impressions.jsonl to.1.N when it exceeds this many bytes. Set 0 to disable. Default 32MB.

recallImpressionsRotateKeep.description: Number of rotated recall-impression archives to keep (.1..N). Default 5. Max 1000: each retained slot costs one rename under the held impressions lock per rotation, so a larger value is rejected at config-parse time before it can stall recall recording.

recallMaxConcurrentPerPrincipal.description: Max concurrent recalls per principal. Extra recalls queue FIFO; an aborted waiter leaves immediately. 0 = unlimited. Budget peek/record stay synchronous. Set 1 to restore exact serialization.

recallMemoryHandles.description: append stable short handles (`[m:4f2a]`) to injected memory lines at recall render time. Default false: off = byte-identical injection. Token cost ~9 chars/memory; flip the default only with benchmark evidence that answer quality is unaffected.

recallMemoryWorthFilterEnabled.description: When true, recall multiplies candidate scores by the Memory Worth factor (mw_success / mw_fail). Failed-session memories sink; neutral memories are untouched. Operators can opt out with false.

recallTrustStageCorpusFallbackEnabled.description: Use cached corpus trust signals for cold recall candidates. Disable to keep only preloaded and direct-read signals.

hotMemoriesCacheEnabled.description: Cache parsed memories by corpus version. Disable to force disk scans.

hotMemoriesCacheTtlMs.description: Maximum cache age in milliseconds; 0 uses version invalidation only. Default 60000.

recallMemoryWorthHalfLifeMs.description: Half-life (ms) for Memory Worth decay. Positive values exponentially decay older outcomes toward the neutral prior; 0 disables decay.

recallMmrEnabled.description: Apply Maximal Marginal Relevance to the final recall selection per-section so one redundant cluster cannot dominate the included context.

recallMmrLambda.description: MMR lambda parameter. 1.0 = pure relevance, 0.0 = pure diversity. Default 0.7 tilts toward relevance with meaningful diversity.

recallMmrTopN.description: Number of top candidates per section to run MMR over. Candidates past this remain in original order.

recallOuterTimeoutMs.description: Outer timeout in ms for the full recall pipeline.

recallPipeline.description: Ordered recall sections with per-section budgets and feature knobs.

maxHints.description: Per-section cap on injected hint lines.

recallPlannerEnabled.description: Use lightweight retrieve-vs-think planning to avoid unnecessary recall work.

recallPlannerLlmEnabled.description: Opt in to LLM-based recall planning. When false, mode uses the regex heuristic. When true, recallPlannerModel classifies intent via the gateway/fallback LLM chain and falls back to the heuristic on timeout/error. Requires recallPlannerEnabled.

recallPlannerMaxMemoryHints.description: Reserved. Caps recent-memory hints in the recall planner prompt when a caller supplies them; the default recall path does not populate hints (the LLM planner classifies on the prompt alone).

recallPlannerMaxPromptChars.description: Maximum characters of prompt context to send to the recall planner.

recallPlannerMaxQmdResultsFull.description: QMD cap used when recall planner selects full mode.

recallPlannerMaxQmdResultsMinimal.description: QMD cap used when recall planner selects minimal mode.

recallPlannerModel.description: Model for LLM-based recall planning (recallPlannerLlmEnabled). A 'provider/model' string resolved through the gateway providers/chain - any configured provider works (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, Codex, gateway personas). Tried first, with taskModelChain / gateway defaults as fallback.

recallPlannerShadowMode.description: Run recall planner in shadow mode - evaluate but do not apply results.

recallPlannerTelemetryEnabled.description: Emit telemetry events for recall planner decisions.

recallPlannerTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for recall planner inference.

recallPlannerUseResponsesApi.description: Reserved. The chat vs Responses API dialect is chosen per-provider by the gateway/fallback client based on each provider's api field, so this flag does not override routing; OpenAI providers already use Responses (gotcha #1).

recallReasoningTraceBoostEnabled.description: Boost stored reasoning_trace memories in recall results when the incoming query reads like a problem-solving ask (e.g. 'how do I..', 'step by step', 'walk me through..'). Default false - opt in after benchmarking.

recallSingleFlightEnabled.description: When true (default), identical concurrent recalls for the same principal share a single in-flight execution (single-flight coalescing, ); each caller still receives its own cloned response and records its own budget event. Set false to restore per-request execution.

recallTranscriptRetentionDays.description: Days of runtime recall audit transcripts to retain before pruning.

recallTranscriptsEnabled.description: Write JSONL recall audit transcripts for runtime recall-context assembly.

recencyWeight.description: Weight for recency boosting in search (0-1)

recordEmptyRecallImpressions.description: Record recall impressions with empty memoryIds when no memory context is added.

reinforcementRecallBoostEnabled.description: When true, memories with reinforcement_count frontmatter receive an additive recall score boost. Default: false (opt-in).

reinforcementRecallBoostMax.description: Maximum additive reinforcement boost per result. Range [0, 1]. Default: 0.3.

reinforcementRecallBoostWeight.description: Score bonus per unit of reinforcement_count (weight * count, capped at max). Range [0, 1]. Default: 0.05.

remoteSearchApiKey.description: API key for remote search backend (when searchBackend=remote)

remoteSearchBaseUrl.description: Base URL for remote search backend (when searchBackend=remote)

remoteSearchTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for remote search backend requests

rerankCacheEnabled.description: Cache re-ranking results in-memory for repeated queries.

rerankEnabled.description: Enable LLM re-ranking of retrieved memories. Default off.

rerankMaxCandidates.description: Max candidates to send to the re-ranker.

rerankProvider.description: Re-ranking provider: 'local' uses local LLM only. 'cloud' is reserved/experimental (currently treated as no-op).

rerankTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for re-ranking requests (ms). Fail-open on timeout.

respectBundledActiveMemoryToggle.description: Compat-only: honor the bundled active-memory session toggle when resolving Remnic recall toggles. Modern memory-slot mode + registerMemoryPromptSection is the primary path; this only matters when chaining Remnic active recall into the bundled active-memory plugin.

responseGuidanceRecallEnabled.description: Enable response guidance recall for user answer-shape preferences.

responseGuidanceRecallMaxChars.description: Character budget for the response guidance recall section.

responseGuidanceRecallMaxResults.description: Maximum recalled items for response guidance.

responseGuidanceRecallScanWindowTokens.description: Recent-token scan window for response guidance.

responseGuidanceRecallScanWindowTurns.description: Recent-turn scan window for response guidance.

resumeBundlesEnabled.description: Enable deterministic resume-bundle storage and operator-facing handoff bundle commands.

routingRulesEnabled.description: Enable custom memory routing rules (v8.7). Default off.

routingRulesStateFile.description: Relative path under memoryDir for persisted routing rules.

scopedCacheInvalidationEnabled.description: Evict only the cache layers a given memory write can affect so a plain fact create no longer nukes the QMD result caches or the version-keyed entity cache. Set false to restore the pre-#1904 full-clear-on-every-write behavior.

scopeProfiles.description: Optional hosted-team memory scope profiles. Profiles define ordered read layers, the default write layer, and authorized promotion target aliases without changing behavior when absent.

searchBackend.description: Search backend: qmd (local hybrid), remote (HTTP REST), noop (disabled), lancedb (embedded hybrid), meilisearch (server-based), orama (embedded JS)

secureStoreEnabled.description: Enable at-rest AES-256-GCM encryption for memory files. When true, the daemon reads and writes memory files through the secure-fs layer. The store must be unlocked via `remnic secure-store unlock` after each daemon start. Default false.

secureStoreEncryptOnWrite.description: When secureStoreEnabled is true, encrypt new memory writes. Set to false to pause new encryptions while still decrypting existing encrypted files (useful during incremental migration). Default true.

semanticChunkingConfig.description: Optional overrides for the semantic chunking algorithm

minTokens.description: Minimum tokens for a segment before merging with neighbor

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens for a segment before recursive splitting

smoothingWindowSize.description: Window size for the moving-average smoothing filter (auto-rounded to odd)

boundaryThresholdStdDevs.description: Standard deviations below mean for boundary detection

fallbackToRecursive.description: Fall back to recursive chunking when embeddings are unavailable

semanticChunkingEnabled.description: Enable semantic chunking with embedding-based topic boundary detection (requires embedding provider)

semanticConsolidationEnabled.description: Enable periodic semantic consolidation of similar memories.

semanticConsolidationExcludeCategories.description: Memory categories excluded from semantic consolidation.

semanticConsolidationIntervalHours.description: Hours between automatic consolidation runs (168 = weekly).

semanticConsolidationMaxPerRun.description: Max memories to consolidate per run to limit LLM cost.

semanticConsolidationMinClusterSize.description: Minimum cluster size before consolidation triggers.

semanticConsolidationModel.description: LLM for consolidation synthesis: 'auto' (primary model), 'fast' (fast local model), or a specific model name.

semanticConsolidationThreshold.description: Token overlap threshold (0-1) for grouping similar memories. 0.8=conservative, 0.6=aggressive.

semanticDedupCandidates.description: Number of nearest-neighbor candidates to inspect during the write-time semantic dedup check. Set to 0 to disable the embedding lookup entirely (equivalent to semanticDedupEnabled=false).

semanticDedupEnabled.description: enable write-time semantic similarity guard that skips near-duplicate facts by comparing embeddings to existing memories. Fails open when the embedding backend is unavailable.

semanticDedupThreshold.description: Cosine similarity threshold in [0, 1]. Candidate facts whose nearest neighbor scores at or above this value are treated as duplicates and skipped.

semanticMerge.description: Judge-mediated merge-on-write. When enabled, a new fact whose nearest neighbor scores in [minSimilarity, semanticDedupThreshold) is offered to an LLM merge judge; a merge verdict updates the existing memory. Every failure creates the new fact.

enabled.description: Master gate. Default off - with it off no lookup and no judge call happen.

minSimilarity.description: Lower bound of the merge band. Must be strictly below semanticDedupThreshold, which owns the near-duplicate skip path above it; an equal or higher value is rejected at config parse time.

maxCandidates.description: Maximum in-band neighbors offered to the merge judge. Set to 0 to disable merging entirely (short-circuits before any embedding lookup).

categories.description: Categories eligible for merging. procedure, reasoning_trace, moment, and correction never merge regardless of this list.

shadowMode.description: Decision-only rollout mode: run the lookup and judge, log the would-merge verdict, then always create. Never mutates an existing memory.

semanticRulePromotionEnabled.description: Enable deterministic promotion of explicit IF/THEN rules from verified episodic memories.

semanticRuleVerificationEnabled.description: Verify promoted semantic rules against their cited source episodes at recall time before surfacing them in recall.

sessionObserverBands.description: Session size bands and growth thresholds for heartbeat observer triggers.

sessionObserverDebounceMs.description: Minimum interval between heartbeat observer triggers per session (ms).

sessionObserverEnabled.description: Enable heartbeat-driven active session observer checks for proactive extraction triggers.

sessionTogglesEnabled.description: Enable per-session recall toggle state for OpenClaw runtime surfaces.

sharedContextAllowBindingAuthority.description: Allow shared-context items to carry binding authority. Writers must still explicitly request binding; without this flag binding writes are rejected and stored binding reads as advisory. Default off.

sharedContextEnabled.description: Enable shared-context assembly and tools (v4.0). Default off.

sharedContextMaxInjectChars.description: Max characters of shared-context to include in each recall context.

sharedCrossSignalSemanticEnabled.description: Enable semantic cross-signal enhancer during shared-context daily curation.

sharedCrossSignalSemanticMaxCandidates.description: Maximum candidate topic tokens considered by semantic cross-signal enhancer.

sharedCrossSignalSemanticTimeoutMs.description: Timeout budget for shared-context semantic cross-signal enhancer (ms).

slowLogEnabled.description: If enabled, log slow operations (durations + metadata; never logs content)

enabled.description: Stamp a `subject` (user|agent) on extracted memories: category defaults (preference/relationship/moment/commitment → user; procedure/principle/skill → agent) with an optional extractor override for fact/decision-like facts. Default off - writes stay byte-identical until enabled.

subjectGuard.description: Guard user-subject promotion to shared layers: off, warn, or enforce. Default warn.

summarizationImportanceThreshold.description: Only compress memories with importance below this threshold

summarizationProtectedTags.description: Tags that protect memories from compression

summarizationRecentToKeep.description: Number of recent memories to keep uncompressed

summarizationTriggerCount.description: Memory count threshold to trigger summarization

summaryModel.description: Model for hourly summaries (defaults to main model)

summaryRecallHours.description: Hours of summary history to recall

supportPassport.description: Owner-controlled support passport cards and timed helper share links. Manual cards and sharing do not require a model provider.

enabled.description: Enable support passport owner routes, MCP tools, browser assets, and public share links.

trustedProxyAddresses.description: Exact reverse-proxy IP addresses allowed to supply X-Forwarded-For for public helper limits.

tagIndexMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of entries in the tag index.

tagMaxPerMemory.description: Maximum number of tags assigned per memory.

tagMemoryEnabled.description: Enable tag-based memory indexing and recall boosting.

tagRecallBoost.description: Score boost applied to memories whose tags match the query.

tagRecallMaxMatches.description: Maximum number of tag-matched memories added per recall.

targetedFactRecallEnabled.description: Enable targeted fact evidence recall for direct answer questions.

targetedFactRecallMaxChars.description: Character budget for the targeted fact evidence recall section.

targetedFactRecallMaxResults.description: Maximum recalled items for targeted fact evidence.

targetedFactRecallScanWindowTokens.description: Recent-token scan window for targeted fact evidence.

targetedFactRecallScanWindowTurns.description: Recent-turn scan window for targeted fact evidence.

taskModelChain.description: Optional gateway model chain for Remnic background LLM work (extraction, consolidation, summarization). When set, resolved through gateway providers instead of gatewayAgentId or agents.defaults.model. Only applies when modelSource is 'gateway'.

fallbacks.description: Fallback gateway models tried after primary

taxonomyAutoGenResolver.description: Auto-regenerate RESOLVER.md when the taxonomy changes.

taxonomyEnabled.description: Enable the MECE taxonomy knowledge directory for categorizing memories.

teams.description: Trusted team membership and team-project namespace templates used by scopeProfiles.

temporalBiTemporal.description: Enable bi-temporal validity filtering for default recall injection. Default false.

temporalBoostRecentDays.description: Memories from the last N days receive a recency boost during recall.

temporalBoostScore.description: Score boost applied to recent memories during recall.

temporalDecayEnabled.description: Apply temporal decay to older memories during recall scoring.

temporalExpiredInInjection.description: Escape hatch for the bi-temporal injection filter. When true, facts whose [valid_at, invalid_at) interval ended before now are kept in injection candidates even with temporalBiTemporal on - some deployments prefer the older (always-inject) behavior.

temporalIndexMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of entries in the temporal index.

temporalIndexWindowDays.description: Number of days to include in the temporal index window.

temporalMemoryTreeEnabled.description: Build a hierarchical memory summary tree (hour/day/week/persona nodes). Default: false.

temporalSupersessionEnabled.description: Mark older facts superseded when a new fact writes a conflicting value for the same entityRef + structuredAttribute key

temporalSupersessionIncludeInRecall.description: If true, include temporally-superseded facts in recall results (for audit/history). Default: exclude.

threadingGapMinutes.description: Minutes of gap to start a new thread

timeGraphEnabled.description: Build temporal sequence graph within threads (requires multiGraphMemoryEnabled). Default true.

tmtHourlyMinMemories.description: Minimum new memories in an hour to trigger an hour-level TMT node. Default: 3.

tmtSummaryMaxTokens.description: Max tokens for each TMT summary node. Default: 300.

tombstonesEnabled.description: Master gate for the tombstone non-resurrection invariant. When true, a fact that matches an active tombstone at the storage chokepoint is persisted as pending_review + blockedBy instead of becoming active - visible, never a silent drop. Off restores pre-feature behavior for rollback safety.

tombstonesSemanticMatch.description: Tier-4 semantic tombstone matching. Off by default; when true the tombstone lookup also checks embedding cosine similarity against tombstoned normalized text. Ships dark until MemCorrect shows an acceptable false-block rate.

tombstonesSemanticThreshold.description: Cosine threshold for tier-4 semantic tombstone matching. Only consulted when tombstonesSemanticMatch is true.

topicExtractionTopN.description: Number of top topics to extract

traceRecallContent.description: If true, include the full recalled memory text in RecallTraceEvent.recalledContent emitted to __openclawEngramTrace subscribers (e.g. Langfuse). Disabled by default - only enable when you want external trace collectors to capture memory context.

traceWeaverEnabled.description: Enable Trace Weaving (v8.0 Phase 2A). Links recurring topic boxes with a shared traceId.

traceWeaverLookbackDays.description: Days back to search for trace links.

traceWeaverOverlapThreshold.description: Minimum Jaccard topic overlap to assign the same traceId (0–1).

transcriptRecallHours.description: Hours of transcript history to recall

transcriptSkipChannelTypes.description: Channel types to skip from transcript logging (e.g., cron)

trustScoreEnabled.description: Master gate for the unified TrustScore recall stage. When off the stage is absent and ranking is byte-identical to the pre-feature pipeline. Flip via #1574 ablation evidence only.

trustScoreEpistemicRendering.description: Append deterministic trust hedges to injected memory lines so the downstream model knows each memory's epistemic status. Separate gate from scoring.

trustScoreMaxMultiplier.description: Upper bound of the trust multiplier mapping [0,1] → [minMultiplier, maxMultiplier].

trustScoreMinMultiplier.description: Lower bound of the trust multiplier mapping [0,1] → [minMultiplier, maxMultiplier].

trustScoreQuarantine.description: Exclude hard-negative (quarantine-band) memories from injection while keeping them visible in X-ray with the reason. Only effective under trustScoreEnabled.

trustScoreWeights.description: Per-component trust weights. Keys: memoryWorth, provenance, faithfulness, corroboration, contradiction, domainCalibration, feedback, recency. Values are numbers in [0,1]; sum-normalized at parse. Invalid entries are dropped.

trustZoneRecallEnabled.description: Add recall-relevant working and trusted trust-zone records to recall context.

trustZoneStoreDir.description: Override the trust-zone store directory (defaults to {memoryDir}/state/trust-zones).

trustZonesEnabled.description: Enable Engram's trust-zone memory foundation for quarantine, working, and trusted records.

verbatimArtifactCategories.description: Memory categories eligible for artifact extraction.

verbatimArtifactsEnabled.description: Write quote-first artifact anchors during extraction and include them in recall.

verbatimArtifactsMaxRecall.description: Maximum artifact anchors added per recall.

verbatimArtifactsMinConfidence.description: Minimum extraction confidence required before writing an artifact.

verboseRecallVisibility.description: Allow verbose recall headers to surface runtime recall diagnostics in prompts.

verifiedRecallEnabled.description: Add recall-relevant memory boxes only when their cited source memories verify as non-archived episodes.

versioningEnabled.description: Enable page-level versioning with sidecar snapshots.

versioningMaxPerPage.description: Maximum number of version snapshots per page. Set to 0 to disable pruning.

versioningSidecarDir.description: Name of the sidecar directory inside memoryDir for version snapshots.

activity.description: Opt-in screen-activity ingestion from trusted local capture daemons, plus optional trust-gated smart extraction of first-person memories.

enabled.description: Master gate for the activity subsystem.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to group captured snapshots into days.

syncDays.description: Number of local days to synchronize per run.

sources.description: Trusted local capture daemons to synchronize.

machineLabel.description: Stable label for the capture machine.

baseUrl.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL of the capture daemon.

token.description: Literal bearer token sent to a trusted local capture daemon over loopback; this parser does not resolve secret references, so omit the field when the daemon needs no auth.

extractionMode.description: Set smart to extract trust-gated personal activity memories. off keeps digests searchable only.

maxMemoriesPerDay.description: Maximum activity memories written per day. Set to 0 for no count cap.

timeline.description: Timeline-card derivation over the activity store: deterministic grouping, categories, idle/pause semantics.

enabled.description: Master gate for timeline-card derivation. Default false.

analysis.description: Optional evidence-bound AI analysis over timeline cards. Default off.

enabled.description: Enable evidence-bound card analysis. Default false.

provider.description: Provider id. Use 'local' for local LLM; otherwise selects one configured remote provider. Required when enabled.

model.description: Model id; may include '/'. Required when enabled.

preferences.description: Up to 16 prompt preferences, 200 characters each.

journal.description: User-owned daily journal files under journal/.

enabled.description: Master gate for remnic journal seed/show. Default false.

source.description: Where a day's journal body is read. 'memoryDir' uses journal/<date>.md under the memory dir. 'vault' reads vault.readback.journalSection in the vault daily note and requires vault.enabled, a resolvable dailyNotePath, and a non-empty journalSection. Legacy 'file' aliases 'memoryDir' and warns.

heading.description: Deprecated alias of activity.timeline.vault.readback.journalSection. Used only when the new key is absent; if both are set the new key wins. Emits a deprecation warning.

extractionMode.description: Review-only journal extraction. 'review' runs a pass over changed journal text producing pending_review candidates only (never auto-approve; no auto mode by design).

enabled.description: Gate remnic timeline range|search. Default false.

maxRangeDays.description: Maximum timeline_range span in days. Integer 1.366.

vault.description: Markdown-vault publisher: write timeline artifacts into daily/weekly vault notes through strictly-bounded managed regions. Default off; enabled=false performs no vault reads or writes.

enabled.description: Master gate for vault publishing. Default false.

vaultPath.description: Vault root, absolute or ~ path. Required and non-empty when enabled. A symlinked root is rejected.

dailyNotePath.description: Vault-relative daily-note path template. Tokens: {yyyy} {yy} {M} {MM} {d} {dd} {ww} {MMM} {MMMM} {ddd} {dddd} (English names). Unknown tokens are rejected at config load naming the token and the full valid set.

weeklyNotePath.description: Vault-relative weekly-note path template. Empty means weekly-note publishing is disabled.

createMissingNotes.description: Create a missing note from noteTemplate before publishing. Default false (update-existing only).

noteTemplate.description: Vault-relative template file used only when createMissingNotes creates a note; its content passes through the same date-token expansion. Required when createMissingNotes is true.

sectionStrategy.description: How Remnic owns a section: HTML-comment marker pairs, or a uniquely-named heading's body.

publish.description: Per-artifact publish targets. Section names must be non-empty, trimmed, and unique per target file.

timeline.description: Day timeline artifact. Live target: publishes the persisted day recap.

enabled.description: Gate for publishing the timeline artifact.

target.description: Which note file receives the artifact.

section.description: Managed-region (or heading) name for this artifact.

standup.description: Standup artifact; lights up when timeline phase 3 lands.

enabled.description: Gate for publishing the standup artifact.

target.description: Which note file receives the artifact.

section.description: Managed-region (or heading) name for this artifact.

weekly.description: Weekly review artifact; lights up when timeline phase 4 lands. Requires weeklyNotePath.

enabled.description: Gate for publishing the weekly artifact.

target.description: Which note file receives the artifact.

section.description: Managed-region (or heading) name for this artifact.

locations.description: Location day line; lights up with the location day renderer.

enabled.description: Gate for publishing the locations artifact.

target.description: Which note file receives the artifact.

section.description: Managed-region (or heading) name for this artifact.

insertUnderHeading.description: Markers strategy: heading under which missing marker pairs are inserted. Empty means never insert; unmarked notes are skipped with reason 'no marker'.

wikilinks.description: Obsidian wikilink decoration. Applies when the locations target lights up.

placesFolder.description: Vault folder used for place wikilink targets.

properties.description: Where artifact stats are written. 'off' writes none; 'frontmatter' adds/updates only prefix-owned keys via targeted line edits; 'dataview-inline' appends inline fields inside the managed region.

autoPublish.description: Publish after each successful artifact generation, once those hooks land. The CLI is always available.

journalSection.description: Heading whose section of the daily note is the user's journal. Arbitrary user-chosen text (any language, emoji, punctuation) matched exactly. Required non-empty when timeline.journal.source is 'vault'.

wearables.description: Wearable transcript ingestion (Limitless / Bee / Omi). Connector packages install a la carte: @remnic/connector-limitless, @remnic/connector-bee, @remnic/connector-omi.

enabled.description: Master gate for the wearables subsystem.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to bucket transcripts into days. Defaults to the host timezone.

redactionEnabled.description: Redact SSN / payment-card patterns from transcripts before storage and extraction.

redactionPatterns.description: Additional user-supplied redaction regexes (validated at config load).

offTheRecordEnabled.description: Honor a spoken 'off the record' marker by eliding segments until 'back on the record'.

offTheRecordMarkers.description: Off-the-record marker phrases. Built-in phrases cover a documented language set; these fields add more.

start.description: Additional phrases that begin an off-the-record span.

end.description: Additional phrases that end an off-the-record span.

useBuiltIns.description: Include the built-in off-the-record phrases. Set false to honor only the configured phrases.

fillerTokens.description: Additional filler tokens removed when a source enables cleanup.stripFillers. Built-in tokens are selected per script.

digestEnabled.description: Write one compact daily-digest memory per synced source/day.

autoSyncEnabled.description: Periodically refresh transcripts in-process on long-lived hosts. Every tick re-syncs a rolling window ending today (existing day files included).

autoSyncDays.description: Rolling window (days ending today) refreshed on each auto-sync tick.

autoSyncDeepDays.description: Once-per-local-day deep refresh window (days) for late uploads and provider re-processing. 0 disables; otherwise must be >= autoSyncDays.

corrections.description: User-specific transcript correction rules applied on every sync (merged with CLI-managed rules).

match.description: Text (or regex when regex=true) to match.

regex.description: Treat match as a regular expression.

sources.description: Restrict the rule to specific source ids.
Per-source settings keyed by connector id (limitless, bee, omi, or a custom connector id).

enabled.description: Enable syncing from this wearable source.

apiKey.description: Provider API credential. Prefer the per-connector environment variable (e.g. ${LIMITLESS_API_KEY}); a config value takes precedence when both are set.

baseUrl.description: Override the provider base URL (self-hosted / local-proxy setups, e.g. the Bee local proxy).

appId.description: Omi only: integration app id (the {app_id} path component of the Omi Integrations API).

userId.description: Omi only: target user id supplied as the uid query parameter.

memoryMode.description: Memory creation trust gate: smart (default) = LLM-judge + per-source trust prior + cross-device corroboration decide active/review/drop automatically; off = transcripts only; review = every candidate lands pending_review; auto = deterministic gates only, survivors active.

sourceTrust.description: Trust prior for this source's transcription quality (0.1). Multiplies extraction confidence in smart mode - lower it for a device that mis-transcribes often.

autoApproveTrust.description: Smart mode: trust score at/above which facts are written active.

reviewTrust.description: Smart mode: trust score at/above which borderline facts are queued for review instead of dropped. Must be below autoApproveTrust.

minConfidence.description: Drop extracted facts below this confidence.

minImportance.description: Drop extracted facts scored below this importance level.

maxMemoriesPerDay.description: Cap on memories created per source per day. 0 (the default) disables the cap.

importNativeMemories.description: Import provider-extracted memories (Bee facts / Omi memories): smart (default) routes them through the same judge + trust pipeline with a reduced prior; review always queues; off skips.

dropLowQuality.description: Drop segments that look like ASR garbage.

preserveUtteranceBoundaries.description: Keep utterance-level boundaries (one segment per utterance) instead of merging consecutive same-speaker segments. Defaults off; Bee enables this by default.

fusion.description: Cross-source fusion of multi-source wearable transcripts into one reconciled artifact per real-world conversation. Deterministic and disabled by default.

enabled.description: Master gate for cross-source fusion. When false, no fusion artifacts are written and no behavior changes.

proximityGapMs.description: Max gap (ms) between two conversations to merge into one fused cluster.

windowToleranceMs.description: Max drift (ms) for two segments to align across sources.

meetings.description: Retrospective meeting intelligence: detect + fuse meetings from ingested audio + screen activity. Disabled by default.

enabled.description: Master gate for the meetings subsystem.

appPatterns.description: Additional meeting-app match patterns, additive over the shipped defaults (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Webex, Slack huddles, FaceTime).

minOverlapMinutes.description: Minimum app-span/audio-window overlap (minutes) to pair them into a meeting.

audioOnlyMinMinutes.description: Audio-only fallback: minimum conversation length (minutes) with >= 2 non-wearer speakers to detect a meeting without an app span.

mergeGapMinutes.description: Merge adjacent same-app candidates within this gap (minutes) - rejoin-after-drop.

contextDwellSeconds.description: Minimum other-app foreground dwell (seconds) to include a span in the meeting's screen-context timeline.

maxContextChars.description: Cap on total deduped screen-context excerpt characters.

summaryMode.description: LLM meeting-summary mode: off (episode only), review (queue all candidates), smart (trust-gated).

sourceTrust.description: Provenance trust prior for meeting-derived facts (0.1).

autoApproveTrust.description: Trust at/above which a smart-mode meeting fact is auto-approved to active.

reviewTrust.description: Trust at/above which a smart-mode meeting fact is queued for review.

location.description: Opt-in location context foundation: day-bucketed place observations from registered providers. Providers are registered by host adapters; no provider client ships in core.

enabled.description: Master gate for the location subsystem.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to bucket observations into local days.

syncDays.description: Number of local days to synchronize per run.

retainCoordinates.description: When false (default), place coordinates are dropped before any persistence or rendering; only place labels are kept.

minimumOverlapSeconds.description: Minimum overlap in seconds for a location tag match. 0 disables the floor.

minimumConfidence.description: Minimum provider-reported place confidence in [0,1] for a tagging match.

enabled.description: When false, no memory is tagged with location context.

backfillEnabled.description: Extra gate for the historical backfill command.

sources.description: Location sources: registered provider ids plus their per-source toggle.

enabled.description: Set false to short-circuit this source only.

indexFilesEnabled.description: Generate index.md files in the live store. false removes generated indexes.

workIndexAutoRebuildDebounceMs.description: Debounce delay in ms before triggering auto-rebuild of the work index.

workIndexAutoRebuildEnabled.description: Automatically rebuild the work index when tasks or projects change.

workIndexDir.description: Override the work index directory (defaults to {memoryDir}/work/index).

workIndexEnabled.description: Enable search index for work tasks and projects.

workProductLedgerDir.description: Override the work-product ledger directory (defaults to {memoryDir}/state/work-product-ledger).

workProductRecallEnabled.description: Add recall-relevant work-product ledger entries to recall context and expose artifact-recovery search tooling.

workProjectIndexEnabled.description: Include projects in the work search index.

workProjectsDir.description: Override the work projects directory (defaults to {memoryDir}/work/projects).

workProjectsEnabled.description: Enable project tracking within the work product system.

workTaskIndexEnabled.description: Include tasks in the work search index.

workTasksDir.description: Override the work tasks directory (defaults to {memoryDir}/work/tasks).

workTasksEnabled.description: Enable task tracking within the work product system.

externalWikis.description: External compiled-wiki roots available only to dedicated on-demand search.

rootDir.description: Absolute path or ~/ path to the external wiki root.

indexInQmd.description: Index the corpus in its dedicated external-wiki collection.

includeInDefaultRecall.description: Reserved safety guard. Remnic rejects true.

extractionBreakerAuthCooldownMs.description: Extraction circuit-breaker open cooldown (ms) for auth/config failures (401/403 or no models configured).

extractionBreakerCooldownMs.description: Extraction circuit-breaker open cooldown (ms) for transient provider failures (429/5xx/network).

extractionBreakerFailureThreshold.description: Consecutive provider failures before the extraction circuit breaker opens and short-circuits extraction.

extractionParseEmptyMaxAttempts.description: Attempts for a parse_empty extraction fingerprint before it is long-parked (still never marked processed).

extractionRetryEnabled.description: Master gate for extraction retry backoff + circuit breaker. When false, restores pre-change behavior (extractor called on every triggered observe, no gate).

extractionRetryJitterRatio.description: Multiplicative jitter ratio (+/-) applied to each extraction backoff interval.

extractionRetryMaxBackoffMs.description: Upper bound (ms) on any single extraction backoff interval and the long-park interval for exhausted parse_empty fingerprints.

extractionRetryScheduleMs.description: Per-fingerprint exponential extraction backoff schedule (ms), indexed by attempt.

bridgeMode.description: Bridge mode: embedded, delegate, or same-memory auto delegation. Environment override supported.

bridgeHealthTimeoutMs.description: Total timeout in milliseconds for delegate liveness and older-daemon detailed-health fallback probes.

extraction.description: Span-mode extraction (Phase B, bench-gated). Default off; shadow requests spans alongside content and persists the generated content unchanged.

spanMode.description: "off" (default) generates content as before. "shadow" requests spans and content for telemetry only and persists generated content. "on" persists materialized frame+span content, falling back per fact when a span fails validation. Unrecognized values are rejected.

openaiApiKey.label: OpenAI API Key
openaiApiKey.help: Optional API key for plugin mode only. Not needed when Model Source is gateway.

openaiBaseUrl.label: OpenAI Base URL
openaiBaseUrl.help: Override for OpenAI-compatible providers (Scryr, Together, OpenRouter, etc.)

memoryOsPreset.label: Memory OS Preset
memoryOsPreset.help: Optional preset: conservative, balanced, research-max, or local-llm-heavy. `research` remains accepted as a backward-compatible alias. Explicit settings still win.

hostEmbeddingProviderEnabled.label: Use Host Embeddings
hostEmbeddingProviderEnabled.help: Prefer OpenClaw's registered embedding providers when available; Remnic falls back automatically.

openclawMessageReceivedCaptureEnabled.label: Capture Inbound Messages
openclawMessageReceivedCaptureEnabled.help: Use OpenClaw message_received transcript capture when the host emits it.

openclawReplyMetadataCaptureEnabled.label: Capture Reply Metadata
openclawReplyMetadataCaptureEnabled.help: Store bounded message/thread/reply fields in transcript metadata.

openclawReplyMetadataExtractionHintsEnab.label: Use Reply Extraction Hints
openclawReplyMetadataExtractionHintsEnab.help: Include bounded quoted-reply context in extraction prompts. Off by default.

openclawChannelEnvelopeCleaningEnabled.label: Clean Channel Envelopes
openclawChannelEnvelopeCleaningEnabled.help: Use OpenClaw's canonical channel envelope prefixes when available.

openclawFlushPlanProcessingEnabled.label: Process Flush Plans
openclawFlushPlanProcessingEnabled.help: Have Remnic ingest and clear OpenClaw's append-only flush-plan file. Disable when OpenClaw owns this lifecycle natively.

qmdColdTierEnabled.label: Enable Cold QMD Tier
qmdColdTierEnabled.help: When hot recall misses, query a secondary cold QMD collection before the query-aware fallback

qmdTierAutoBackfillEnabled.label: Tier Auto Backfill
qmdTierAutoBackfillEnabled.help: Enable automated cold-tier backfill runs for parity repair

qmdAutoUpgradeEnabled.label: QMD Auto Upgrade
qmdAutoUpgradeEnabled.help: Upgrade PATH/fallback QMD installs to the supported version; explicit qmdPath installs are skipped

qmdSearchStrategy.label: QMD Search Strategy
qmdSearchStrategy.help: hybrid = lex+vec+hyde (default, best recall). lex-vec drops HyDE. lex = BM25-only (fastest). Lower tiers reduce CPU latency at the cost of recall.

qmdSubprocessStrategy.label: QMD Subprocess Strategy
qmdSubprocessStrategy.help: query = qmd query with LLM expansion + rerank (default). search = BM25-only fallback, faster on huge collections but loses expansion/rerank.

qmdIndexName.label: QMD Index Name
qmdIndexName.help: Use a named QMD index when QMD 2.5+ supports --index. Changing this selects a different SQLite DB; keep it unset for existing default-index installs.

qmdForceCpu.label: QMD Force CPU
qmdForceCpu.help: Set QMD_FORCE_CPU=1 for QMD child processes

embeddingFallbackEnabled.label: Embedding Fallback
embeddingFallbackEnabled.help: Use semantic embeddings when QMD is unavailable or no results are found

embeddingFallbackModel.label: Embedding Model
embeddingFallbackModel.help: Optional embedding model for semantic fallback. Use this when the local chat model and embedding model are different.

qmdPath.label: QMD Path
qmdPath.help: Optional absolute path to qmd binary for environments with unstable PATH/bun shims

identityEnabled.label: Identity Reflections
identityEnabled.help: Append self-reflections to workspace IDENTITY.md after each extraction

identityInjectionMode.label: Identity Context Mode
identityInjectionMode.help: When to add identity continuity context: recovery_only, minimal, or full

continuityIncidentLoggingEnabled.label: Continuity Incident Logging
continuityIncidentLoggingEnabled.help: When omitted, follows Identity Continuity enabled state

sessionObserverEnabled.label: Session Observer
sessionObserverEnabled.help: Observe heartbeat growth and proactively trigger extraction when configured thresholds are crossed

sessionObserverBands.label: Observer Size Bands
sessionObserverBands.help: Array of {maxBytes, triggerDeltaBytes, triggerDeltaTokens} threshold objects

commitmentDecayDays.label: Commitment Decay (days)
commitmentDecayDays.help: Positive integer days before fulfilled/expired commitments are removed.

accessTrackingEnabled.label: Access Tracking
accessTrackingEnabled.help: Track which memories are accessed most frequently

recencyWeight.label: Recency Weight
recencyWeight.help: How much to boost recent memories in search (0-1)

boostAccessCount.label: Boost Frequent Access
boostAccessCount.help: Rank frequently accessed memories higher in search

captureMode.label: Capture Mode
captureMode.help: Choose whether Engram stores only explicit notes, normal extraction, or both.

agentAccessHttp.label: Local HTTP Access
agentAccessHttp.help: Enable a local authenticated HTTP API for external Engram clients

negativeExamplesEnabled.label: Negative Examples
negativeExamplesEnabled.help: Track retrieved-but-not-useful memories and apply a small ranking penalty (optional)

chunkingEnabled.label: Enable Chunking
chunkingEnabled.help: Automatically split long memories into overlapping chunks for better retrieval

semanticChunkingEnabled.label: Semantic Chunking
semanticChunkingEnabled.help: Use embedding-based topic detection for more coherent chunks (requires chunking enabled)

semanticChunkingConfig.label: Semantic Chunking Config
semanticChunkingConfig.help: Override defaults for semantic chunking algorithm parameters

contradictionDetectionEnabled.label: Contradiction Detection
contradictionDetectionEnabled.help: Detect and resolve conflicting memories using LLM verification

contradictionAutoResolve.label: Auto-Resolve Contradictions
contradictionAutoResolve.help: Automatically supersede old memories when contradiction is confirmed

contradictionScan.label: Contradiction Scan
contradictionScan.help: Nightly cron that pairs similar memories and flags contradictions for review

contradictionLocalization.label: Contradiction Localization
contradictionLocalization.help: Find entityRef and category anchors before QMD search.

dependencyPropagation.label: Dependency Propagation
dependencyPropagation.help: Revalidate active dependent memories after supersession. Disabled by default.

converge.conflictPolicy.label: Converge Conflict Policy
converge.conflictPolicy.help: newest-wins selects the newer revision when both sides carry comparable timestamps; manual stops before mutation when conflicts remain. Default: newest-wins. The --conflict-policy CLI flag overrides this setting.

temporalSupersessionEnabled.label: Temporal Supersession
temporalSupersessionEnabled.help: Mark older facts superseded when a newer fact writes a conflicting value for the same entityRef + structured attribute

temporalSupersessionIncludeInRecall.label: Include Superseded Facts In Recall
temporalSupersessionIncludeInRecall.help: If enabled, superseded facts still surface in recall (audit/history mode).

temporalBiTemporal.label: Bi-temporal Validity
temporalBiTemporal.help: Master gate: resolve per-fact event-time at write time and exclude validity-expired facts from injection by default. Off = byte-identical to pre-#1578.

temporalExpiredInInjection.label: Keep Expired-Validity Facts In Injection
temporalExpiredInInjection.help: Escape hatch: keep facts whose event-time interval ended in injection candidates even with bi-temporal on.

recallDirectAnswerEnabled.label: Direct-Answer Retrieval Tier
recallDirectAnswerEnabled.help: Opt in to the direct-answer retrieval tier for validated high-trust queries before QMD.

recallDisclosureEscalation.label: Disclosure Auto-Escalation
recallDisclosureEscalation.help: Auto-promote default chunk recalls to section when top-K confidence is low. Set to 'auto' to enable; 'manual' (default) preserves pre-#677 behavior.

recallDisclosureEscalationThreshold.label: Disclosure Escalation Threshold
recallDisclosureEscalationThreshold.help: Top-K confidence (0-1) below which auto-escalation triggers. Only consulted when Disclosure Auto-Escalation is set to 'auto'.

recallGraphEnabled.label: Graph Retrieval (PPR)
recallGraphEnabled.help: Run Personalized PageRank on the retrieval graph and merge with QMD via MMR.

graphPathScoring.label: Graph Path Scoring
graphPathScoring.help: Penalize expanded results that rely on invalid intermediate memories. Disabled by default.

memoryLinkingEnabled.label: Memory Linking
memoryLinkingEnabled.help: Build knowledge graph by linking related memories

threadingEnabled.label: Conversation Threading
threadingEnabled.help: Group memories into conversation threads with auto-titles

summarizationEnabled.label: Memory Summarization
summarizationEnabled.help: Compress old, low-importance memories into summaries

topicExtractionEnabled.label: Topic Extraction
topicExtractionEnabled.help: Extract key topics from memory corpus

transcriptEnabled.label: Enable Transcript Archive
transcriptEnabled.help: Archive conversation transcripts for context preservation

transcriptSkipChannelTypes.label: Skip Channel Types
transcriptSkipChannelTypes.help: Channel types to exclude from transcript logging (default: cron)

checkpointEnabled.label: Enable Checkpoints
checkpointEnabled.help: Capture conversation checkpoints for resuming context

compactionResetEnabled.label: Compaction Reset
compactionResetEnabled.help: Reset session after compaction and add BOOT.md recovery context

hourlySummariesEnabled.label: Enable Hourly Summaries
hourlySummariesEnabled.help: Generate hourly summaries of conversation activity

supportPassport.label: Support Passport
supportPassport.help: Enable owner-controlled support cards and timed helper share links. Model calls use Remnic's configured provider routes.

modelSource.label: Model Source
modelSource.help: Route LLM calls through the gateway's agent model chain instead of Engram's own config. Default for OpenClaw installs. When set to 'gateway', localLlm and openai settings are ignored.

gatewayAgentId.label: Gateway Agent ID
gatewayAgentId.help: Agent persona ID from openclaw.json agents.list[] whose model chain to use. Leave empty to use global defaults.

fastGatewayAgentId.label: Fast Gateway Agent ID
fastGatewayAgentId.help: Agent persona ID for fast-tier ops. Leave empty to use the primary gatewayAgentId.

taskModelChain.label: Task Model Chain
taskModelChain.help: Optional primary/fallback gateway model chain for Remnic background tasks (extraction, consolidation, summarization). Overrides gatewayAgentId/defaults for these tasks only. Requires modelSource: 'gateway'.

localLlmEnabled.label: Enable Local LLM
localLlmEnabled.help: Use local LLM (LM Studio, Ollama, etc.) for extraction and summaries. Falls back to OpenAI if unavailable.

localLlmUrl.label: Local LLM URL
localLlmUrl.help: OpenAI-compatible endpoint URL for local LLM

localLlmModel.label: Local LLM Model
localLlmModel.help: Model identifier for local LLM requests

localLlmApiKey.label: Local LLM API Key
localLlmApiKey.help: Optional API key for authenticated OpenAI-compatible endpoints

localLlmHeaders.label: Local LLM Headers
localLlmHeaders.help: Optional extra headers for provider-specific routing/auth

localLlmAuthHeader.label: Send Auth Header
localLlmAuthHeader.help: When false, do not send Authorization header even if localLlmApiKey is set

localLlmFallback.label: Local LLM Fallback
localLlmFallback.help: Legacy alias for taskLlmFallback. Use the gateway/task LLM chain when local LLM fails or is unavailable.

taskLlmFallback.label: Task LLM Fallback
taskLlmFallback.help: Use the gateway/task LLM chain when the local LLM path fails or is unavailable.

taskLlmTimeoutMs.label: Task LLM Timeout (ms)
taskLlmTimeoutMs.help: Timeout for the gateway/task LLM chain. In gateway mode this is the primary extraction timeout.

localLlmHomeDir.label: Local LLM Home Dir
localLlmHomeDir.help: Optional home directory override for LM Studio settings and local helper paths.

localLmsCliPath.label: LMS CLI Path
localLmsCliPath.help: Optional absolute path to LMS CLI. Overrides auto-detection.

localLlmMaxContext.label: Local LLM Max Context
localLlmMaxContext.help: Override context window if your LLM server uses smaller default (e.g., 32768 for LM Studio default)

localLlmFastEnabled.label: Fast LLM Tier
localLlmFastEnabled.help: Use a separate smaller model for quick operations (rerank, entity summaries, compression guidelines)

localLlmFastModel.label: Fast LLM Model
localLlmFastModel.help: Model ID for fast-tier operations. Must be loaded in LM Studio alongside the primary model.

localLlmFastUrl.label: Fast LLM URL
localLlmFastUrl.help: Endpoint for fast-tier model. When not set, inherits the primary localLlmUrl.

localLlmFastTimeoutMs.label: Fast LLM Timeout (ms)
localLlmFastTimeoutMs.help: Timeout for fast-tier requests. Lower than primary since fast ops should complete quickly.

localLlmDisableThinking.label: Disable Local LLM Thinking Mode
localLlmDisableThinking.help: Suppress thinking for supported local extraction operations. Short extractions can opt back in with Local LLM Thinking Threshold. Consolidation and the fast tier are unaffected.

localLlmThinkingThresholdChars.label: Local LLM Thinking Threshold (chars)
localLlmThinkingThresholdChars.help: Enable thinking only for local extraction transcripts shorter than this length. Set to 0 to suppress thinking for every extraction. Consolidation is unaffected.

evalHarnessEnabled.label: Evaluation Harness
evalHarnessEnabled.help: Enable Engram's benchmark/evaluation harness foundation and benchmark-status diagnostics.

evalShadowModeEnabled.label: Evaluation Shadow Mode
evalShadowModeEnabled.help: Reserve shadow-mode measurement paths so future benchmark instrumentation can compare memory behavior without affecting live recall.

benchmarkBaselineSnapshotsEnabled.label: Benchmark Baseline Snapshots
benchmarkBaselineSnapshotsEnabled.help: Enable versioned benchmark baseline snapshot artifacts for later PR delta reporting.

benchmarkDeltaReporterEnabled.label: Benchmark Delta Reporter
benchmarkDeltaReporterEnabled.help: Enable named-baseline delta reports that compare the current eval store against a stored benchmark baseline snapshot.

evalStoreDir.label: Evaluation Store Directory
evalStoreDir.help: Override where benchmark packs and run summaries are stored.

objectiveStateMemoryEnabled.label: Objective-State Memory
objectiveStateMemoryEnabled.help: Enable the objective-state memory foundation for normalized world and tool state snapshots.

objectiveStateSnapshotWritesEnabled.label: Objective-State Snapshot Writes
objectiveStateSnapshotWritesEnabled.help: Allow snapshot writers to persist objective-state records into the objective-state store.

objectiveStateStoreDir.label: Objective-State Store Directory
objectiveStateStoreDir.help: Override where objective-state snapshots are stored.

causalTrajectoryMemoryEnabled.label: Causal Trajectory Memory
causalTrajectoryMemoryEnabled.help: Enable the causal-trajectory memory foundation for typed goal-action-observation-outcome chains.

causalTrajectoryStoreDir.label: Causal Trajectory Store Directory
causalTrajectoryStoreDir.help: Override where causal-trajectory records are stored.

trustZonesEnabled.label: Trust Zones
trustZonesEnabled.help: Enable the trust-zone memory foundation for quarantine, working, and trusted records.

trustZoneStoreDir.label: Trust-Zone Store Directory
trustZoneStoreDir.help: Override where trust-zone records are stored.

memoryPoisoningDefenseEnabled.label: Memory Poisoning Defense
memoryPoisoningDefenseEnabled.help: Enable provenance trust scoring in trust-zone status output as the first poisoning-defense signal.

memoryInjectionDefenseMode.label: Memory Injection Defense
memoryInjectionDefenseMode.help: off, fencing, quarantine, or layered; custom keeps the separate flags.

injectionScreenEnabled.label: Injection Screen
injectionScreenEnabled.help: Screen candidate facts with deterministic rules and queue findings for review.

memoryRedTeamBenchEnabled.label: Memory Red-Team Benchmarks
memoryRedTeamBenchEnabled.help: Enable operator-facing red-team benchmark pack support and status accounting for poisoning-defense suites.

abstractionNodeStoreDir.label: Abstraction-Node Store Directory
abstractionNodeStoreDir.help: Override where abstraction nodes are stored.

semanticRulePromotionEnabled.label: Semantic Rule Promotion
semanticRulePromotionEnabled.help: Promote explicit IF/THEN rules from verified episodic memories into durable rule memories.

operatorAwareConsolidationEnabled.label: Operator-Aware Consolidation
operatorAwareConsolidationEnabled.help: Opt in to operator-aware consolidation instructions (default off). When enabled, the LLM returns structured {operator, output} JSON and we record SPLIT/MERGE/UPDATE on derived_via. When disabled (default), derived_via still populates via the cluster-shape heuristic.

peerProfileReasonerEnabled.label: Peer Profile Reasoner
peerProfileReasonerEnabled.help: Enable the async peer profile reasoner. Runs in the REM phase after semantic consolidation and updates per-peer profile.md files with provenance-tagged field updates derived from each peer's interaction log. Default off (opt-in).

peerProfileReasonerModel.label: Peer Profile Reasoner Model
peerProfileReasonerModel.help: Model identifier the peer profile reasoner records on telemetry. Dispatch still routes through the FallbackLlmClient used by semantic consolidation.

peerProfileReasonerMaxFieldsPerRun.label: Peer Profile Reasoner Max Fields Per Run

peerProfileRecallEnabled.label: Peer Profile Recall
peerProfileRecallEnabled.help: When enabled, adds the active peer's profile fields to recall context as a '## Peer Profile' section. Requires the session peer ID to be registered. Default off.

peerProfileRecallMaxFields.label: Peer Profile Recall Max Fields
peerProfileRecallMaxFields.help: Maximum number of peer profile fields to add per recall. Only the most-recently-updated N fields are included. Set to 0 to disable this feature.

promotionByOutcomeEnabled.label: Promotion By Outcome
promotionByOutcomeEnabled.help: Enable outcome-aware promotion controls that will consume learned utility signals in later rollout slices.

commitmentLifecycleEnabled.label: Commitment Lifecycle
commitmentLifecycleEnabled.help: Enable fulfillment transitions, stale tracking, and resolved-entry cleanup for the commitment ledger.

commitmentStaleDays.label: Commitment Stale Days
commitmentStaleDays.help: Days before an open commitment without a due date counts as stale.

commitmentLedgerDir.label: Commitment Ledger Directory
commitmentLedgerDir.help: Override where commitment ledger entries are stored.

resumeBundlesEnabled.label: Resume Bundles
resumeBundlesEnabled.help: Enable deterministic resume-bundle storage and explicit handoff bundle commands.

resumeBundleDir.label: Resume Bundle Directory
resumeBundleDir.help: Override where resume bundles are stored.

workProductLedgerDir.label: Work-Product Ledger Directory
workProductLedgerDir.help: Override where work-product ledger entries are stored.

factDeduplicationEnabled.label: Fact Deduplication
factDeduplicationEnabled.help: Prevent storing semantically identical facts using content hashing

semanticDedupEnabled.label: Semantic Dedup (write-time)
semanticDedupEnabled.help: Skip near-duplicate facts at write time by comparing embeddings to existing memories.

factArchivalEnabled.label: Fact Archival
factArchivalEnabled.help: Automatically archive old, low-importance, rarely-accessed facts during consolidation
